title.zh: 卷十三 志第三 天文下
title.raw: 卷十三 志第三 天文下 Volume 13 Treatises 3: Astronomy Part Three

meta.sourceNote: ChineseNotes scrape had missing text or source glyph artifacts; chapter body imported from Wikisource after ChineseNotes glossary scrape.

sentences.zh: 月五星犯列舍經星變附見

translations.literal: Moon and five planets offending listed lodges and classical fixed stars changing; appended sightings recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Transits of the moon and five planets against lunar lodges and principal fixed stars, with appended anomaly records.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝黃初四年三月癸卯，月犯心大星。

translations.literal: Wei Wendi, Huangchu fourth year, third month, guimao: the moon offended the great star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Huangchu under Wei Emperor Wen, on the guimao day of the third lunar month, the moon transgressed the principal star of the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「心為天王位，王者惡之。

translations.literal: The prognostication text says, "Heart is the throne-seat of the celestial king; the king abhors it.
translations.idiomatic: The divination reads, "Heart marks the ruler’s celestial throne; the sovereign dreads such an omen.

translations.literal: " In the sixth month, jiashen, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiashen, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 案劉向《五紀論》曰：「太白少陰，弱，不得專行，故以己未為界，不得經天而行。

translations.literal: Investigating, Liu Xiang’s "Five Eras Treatise" says, "Great White is lesser yin, weak, cannot go alone; therefore taking jiwei as the limit, it may not thread the sky and travel.
translations.idiomatic: Note Liu Xiang’s "Treatise on the Five Eras": Venus is minor yin and too faint to move independently, so within certain bounds it must not cross the meridian and traverse the full sky.

sentences.zh: 經天則晝見，其占為兵喪，為不臣，為更王；

translations.literal: If it threads the sky then it is seen by day; its prognostications are for weapons and mourning, for disloyal ministers, for changing kings;
translations.idiomatic: When it crosses the zenith it becomes a daytime apparition, portending warfare and mourning, rebellious subjects, and dynastic turnover;

translations.literal: Strong states weaken; small states strengthen.
translations.idiomatic: Great powers decline while lesser polities rise.

sentences.zh: 」是時孫權受魏爵號，而稱兵距守。

translations.literal: " At that time Sun Quan received Wei noble rank, yet raised arms and held out in defense.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Sun Quan accepted Wei ennoblement while still mobilizing troops in defiance.

sentences.zh: 其十二月丙子，月犯心大星。

translations.literal: That twelfth month, bingzi, the moon offended the great star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingzi, the moon again transgressed the principal star of Heart.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The same divination gloss applies as before.

sentences.zh: 五年十月乙卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fifth year, tenth month, yimao, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, tenth month, on yimao, Venus appeared in daylight.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The same divination gloss applies as before.

sentences.zh: 又歲星入太微逆行，積百四十九日乃出。

translations.literal: Further, the Year Star entered Taiwei retrograde, accumulating one hundred forty-nine days then exiting.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Jupiter entered the Supreme Palace enclosure in retrograde motion and remained there one hundred forty-nine days before leaving.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「五星入太微，從右入三十日以上，人主有大憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "When the five stars enter Taiwei, entering from the right and staying thirty days or more, the human lord has great worry.
translations.idiomatic: The text states, "If the five planets enter the Supreme Palace enclosure from the right and remain thirty days or more, the ruler faces grave peril.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "A grant of amnesty will arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Another reading adds, "A general amnesty is impending.

sentences.zh: 」七年五月，帝崩，明帝即位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: " In the seventh year, fifth month, the emperor died; Emperor Ming ascended the throne and granted a great amnesty to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year’s fifth month the emperor died; Emperor Ming succeeded and proclaimed a universal amnesty.

sentences.zh: 六年五月壬戌，熒惑入太微，至壬申，興歲星相及，俱犯右執法，至癸酉乃出。

translations.literal: Sixth year, fifth month, renxu, Sparkling Deluder entered Taiwei; reaching renshen it drew level with the Year Star; both offended the Right Law Enforcer; reaching guiyou it then departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year, on renxu, Mars entered the Supreme Palace enclosure; by renshen it closed on Jupiter; both transgressed the Right Law Enforcer star; they cleared the region by guiyou.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「從右入三十日以上，人主有大憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Entering from the right thirty days or more, the human lord has great worry.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss reads, "A right-hand ingress lasting thirty days or more foretells grave danger for the ruler.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「月、五星犯左右執法，大臣有憂。

translations.literal: " It also says, "When the moon or five planets offend the Left or Right Law Enforcer, great ministers have worry.
translations.idiomatic: It adds, "Lunar or planetary transits across the Left or Right Law Enforcer augur anxiety for senior ministers.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "Law enforcers are executed; metal and fire are especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Another line warns, "Officials charged with justice face execution; Venus and Mars make the omen harshest.

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month the imperial son, Prince Jian of Dongwuyang, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Prince Jian of Dongwuyang, an imperial son, died.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，驃騎將軍曹洪免為庶人。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, Cavalry-in-Attendant General Cao Hong was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year General of Agile Cavalry Cao Hong was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 四月，征南大將軍夏侯尚薨。

translations.literal: Fourth month, South-Conquering Grand General Xiahou Shang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Grand General Who Conquers the South Xiahou Shang died.

translations.literal: Fifth month, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 《蜀記》稱明帝問黃權曰：「天下鼎立，何地為正？

translations.literal: The "Shu Record" states that Emperor Ming asked Huang Quan, saying, "The realm stands tripod-like; which region holds the true mandate?
translations.idiomatic: The Shu Record reports Emperor Ming asking Huang Quan which of the three rival states possessed the legitimate cosmic alignment.

translations.literal: " He answered, "One should verify it against celestial patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Quan replied that the answer lay in inspecting the heavens.

sentences.zh: 往者熒惑守心而文帝崩，吳、蜀無事，此其徵也。

translations.literal: " Formerly Sparkling Deluder guarded Heart and Emperor Wen died, yet Wu and Shu had no incident; this is its sign.
translations.idiomatic: He cited Mars stationing at Heart when Emperor Wen died while Wu and Shu remained unscathed as the relevant precedent.

sentences.zh: 」案三國史並無熒惑守心之文，疑是入太微。

translations.literal: " Investigating the Three Kingdoms histories, there is no text of Sparkling Deluder guarding Heart; it is suspected to mean entering Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Scrutiny shows no record of Mars actually stationing at Heart; the event was likely Mars entering the Supreme Palace enclosure.

sentences.zh: 八月，吳遂圍江夏，寇襄陽，大將軍宣帝救襄陽，斬吳將張霸等，兵喪更王之應也。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Wu then besieged Jiangxia, raided Xiangyang; Grand General the Lord of Xuan rescued Xiangyang, beheaded Wu generals including Zhang Ba: this matches weapons-loss and king-change.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wu besieged Jiangxia and struck Xiangyang; the Lord of Xuan led relief, slew Wu commanders such as Zhang Ba—fulfilling the omen of war, mourning, and shifting supremacy.

sentences.zh: 明帝太和五年五月，熒惑犯房。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming, Taihe fifth year, fifth month, Sparkling Deluder offended Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth Taihe year of Emperor Ming, Mars transgressed the Chamber mansion.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「房四星，股肱臣將相位也，月、五星犯守之，將相有憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Chamber’s four stars are the thigh-and-arm ministers and the chancellor’s phase; when the moon or five planets offend or guard them, generals and chancellors have worry.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss identifies Chamber’s four stars with the sovereign’s chief ministers; lunar or planetary transits there threaten those officers.

sentences.zh: 」其七月，車騎將軍張郃追諸葛亮，為亮所害。

translations.literal: " That seventh month, Chariots-and-Horses General Zhang He pursued Zhuge Liang and was killed by Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang He died pursuing Zhuge Liang.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Grand Commandant Hua Xin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Grand Commandant Hua Xin died.

sentences.zh: 其十一月乙酉，月犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: That eleventh month, yiyou, the moon offended the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the same eleventh month, on yiyou, the moon transgressed the principal star of Xuanyuan (Regulus).

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The chief consort has worry.
translations.idiomatic: The text foretells trouble for the empress or chief consort.

sentences.zh: 」六年三月乙亥，月又犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: " Sixth year, third month, yihai, the moon again offended the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year, on yihai, the moon again transgressed Regulus.

sentences.zh: 十一月寅，太白晝見南斗，遂歷八十餘日，恆見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yin day, Great White was seen by day in Southern Dipper; it then lasted more than eighty days, constantly seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the yin day of the eleventh month Venus stood in daylight within the Southern Dipper and remained visible more than eighty consecutive days.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Wu has weapons.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss predicts military action involving Wu.

sentences.zh: 」明年，孫權遣張彌等將兵萬人，錫授公孫文懿為燕王，文懿斬彌等，虜其眾。

translations.literal: " Next year Sun Quan sent Zhang Mi and others leading ten thousand troops to invest Gongsun Wenyi as King of Yan; Wenyi slew Mi and seized his host.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Sun Quan dispatched Zhang Mi with ten thousand men to enfeoff Gongsun Yuan as King of Yan; Yuan executed the envoys and captured the army.

sentences.zh: 青龍三年正月，太后郭氏崩。

translations.literal: Blue Dragon third year, first month, Empress Dowager Guo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third Blue Dragon year Empress Dowager Guo died.

sentences.zh: 青龍三年三月辛卯，月犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Blue Dragon third year, third month, xinmao, the moon offended Ghost Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third Blue Dragon year, on xinmao, the moon transgressed the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: Ghost Carriage governs beheading and killing.
translations.idiomatic: The Ghost asterism presides over executions and slaughter.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Many people fall ill; the state has worry.
translations.idiomatic: It warns of widespread sickness and national anxiety.

translations.literal: " It also says, "Great ministers have worry.
translations.idiomatic: A second reading adds peril for high ministers.

translations.literal: " That year, summer and winter, great pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: That summer and winter a severe epidemic raged.

translations.literal: Fourth year, fifth month, Minister of Education Dong Zhao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year Minister over the Masses Dong Zhao died.

sentences.zh: 其五月丁亥，太白晝見，積三十餘日。

translations.literal: That fifth month, dinghai, Great White was seen by day, accumulating more than thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the same fifth month, on dinghai, Venus shone in daylight for over thirty days.

sentences.zh: 以晷度推之，非秦魏，則楚也。

translations.literal: By gnomon-shadow degrees extrapolating it, it was not Qin or Wei, then it was Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Shadow-rod reckoning assigned the omen to the Chu sector rather than Qin or Wei heartlands.

sentences.zh: 是時，諸葛亮據渭南，宣帝與相持；

translations.literal: At that time Zhuge Liang held south of the Wei River and the Lord of Xuan faced him in stalemate;
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Liang was entrenched south of the Wei while the Lord of Xuan contained him;

sentences.zh: 孫權寇合肥，又遣陛議、孫韶等人淮沔，天子親東征。

translations.literal: Sun Quan raided Hefei and also sent Lu Yi, Sun Shao, and others into the Huai and Han rivers; the Son of Heaven personally campaigned east.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Quan struck at Hefei and sent Lu Yi, Sun Shao, and others into the Huai-Han basin, prompting an eastern expedition by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 蜀本秦地，則為秦魏及楚兵悉起矣。

translations.literal: Shu is fundamentally Qin territory, so Qin, Wei, and Chu arms all rose together.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shu occupied the old Qin domain, the omen materialized as simultaneous warfare across the Qin, Wei, and Chu astrological divisions.

translations.literal: That seventh month, jisi, the moon offended Key-and-Bar.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jisi, the moon transgressed the Key-and-Bar stars.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "There is fire disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss portends conflagration.

translations.literal: " Third year, seventh month, the Chonghua Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year the Chonghua Palace caught fire.

sentences.zh: 三年六月丁未，填星犯井鉞。

translations.literal: Third year, sixth month, dingwei, Station Star offended Well’s axe-star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, on dingwei, Saturn transgressed the axe star of Eastern Well.

translations.literal: On wuxu, Great White again offended it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Venus likewise transgressed that star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「凡月、五星犯井鉞，悉為兵災。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Whenever the moon or five planets offend Well’s axe, all mean weapon disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The text states that lunar or planetary hits on the Well axe-star always presage military calamity.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "Axes and halberds are used; great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Another line warns of capital punishment falling on senior officials.

translations.literal: " Seventh month, jichou, Station Star offended Eastern Well’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the seventh month Saturn transgressed the separation star of Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "When Station Star enters Well, great men have worry.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn entering the Well mansion augurs anxiety for high lords.

translations.literal: " Moving near the separation star counts as traveling the yin aspect.
translations.idiomatic: Passing close to the separation star is interpreted as motion along the yin side of the lodge.

translations.literal: Its prognostication says, "Great flood; the five grains do not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: The associated reading predicts catastrophic flooding and crop failure.

translations.literal: " Jingchu first year, summer, great flood, injuring the five grains.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Jingchu summer floods ruined the harvest.

sentences.zh: 其年十月壬申，太白晝見，在尾，歷二百餘日，恆晝見。

translations.literal: That year, tenth month, renshen, Great White was seen by day, in Tail, lasting more than two hundred days, constantly seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year, on renshen, Venus appeared in daylight in the Tail mansion and remained a daytime object for over two hundred days.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Tail is Yan; there are weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Tail corresponds to the Yan region and foretells war.

translations.literal: " Twelfth month, wuchen, the moon offended Hook-and-Lock.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, the moon transgressed the Hook-and-Lock stars.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The king has worry.
translations.idiomatic: The king himself is said to face peril.

sentences.zh: 」四年閏正月己巳，填星犯井鉞。

translations.literal: " Fourth year, intercalary first month, jisi, Station Star offended Well’s axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary first month of the fourth year, on jisi, Saturn again transgressed the Well axe-star.

translations.literal: Third month, guimao, Station Star offended Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, Saturn transgressed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太白與月加景晝見。

translations.literal: On jisi, Great White together with the Moon, brightness added to the solar glare, were seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Venus and the Moon were visible in daylight, their brilliance heightened against the sunlit sky.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，太白犯畢左股第一星。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renyin, Great White offended the first star of Net’s left thigh.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renyin, Venus transgressed the first star along the left thigh of the Net mansion.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「畢為邊兵，又主刑罰。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Net is border weapons; it also governs punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Net presides over frontier warfare and judicial punishments.

sentences.zh: 」九月，涼州塞外胡阿畢師使侵犯諸國，西域校尉張就討之，斬首捕虜萬計。

translations.literal: " Ninth month, beyond the passes in Liangzhou the Hu chieftain Abi Shi envoys raided the states; Colonel of the Western Regions Zhang Jiu campaigned, beheading and capturing on the order of ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Liangzhou frontier Hu led by Abi Shi’s envoys attacked neighboring states; Colonel of the Western Regions Zhang Jiu crushed them, taking tens of thousands of heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 其年七月甲寅，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: That year, seventh month, jiayin, Great White offended the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year, on jiayin, Venus transgressed Regulus.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The chief consort has worry.
translations.idiomatic: The omen again targets the chief consort.

translations.literal: " Jingchu first year, Empress Mao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Jingchu year Empress Mao died.

sentences.zh: 景初元年二月乙酉，月犯房第二星。

translations.literal: Jingchu first year, second month, yiyou, the moon offended the second star of Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Jingchu year, second month, on yiyou, the moon transgressed the second star of Chamber.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Generals have worry.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss warns of danger to generals.

translations.literal: " That seventh month, Minister of Education Chen Jiao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Minister over the Masses Chen Jiao died.

translations.literal: Second year, fourth month, Minister of Education Han Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year Minister over the Masses Han Ji died.

sentences.zh: 其七月辛卯，太白晝見，積二百八十餘日。

translations.literal: That seventh month, xinmao, Great White was seen by day, accumulating more than two hundred eighty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinmao, Venus remained a daytime object for over two hundred eighty days.

sentences.zh: 時公孫文懿自立為燕王，署置百官，發兵距守，宣帝討滅之。

translations.literal: At that time Gongsun Wenyi had declared himself King of Yan, appointed officials at will, raised troops and held defense; the Lord of Xuan campaigned and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Yuan had styled himself King of Yan, set up a full bureaucracy, and resisted; the Lord of Xuan extirpated the regime.

sentences.zh: 二年二月己丑，月犯心距星，又犯中央大星。

translations.literal: Second year, second month, jichou, the moon offended Heart’s separation star and also offended the central great star.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, on jichou, the moon transgressed Heart’s separation star and the central principal star.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，月又犯心距星及中央大星。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yihai, the moon again offended Heart’s separation star and the central great star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yihai, the moon repeated those transits across Heart.

translations.literal: Investigating, the prognostication says, "The king abhors it.
translations.idiomatic: The compiled gloss states that the sovereign should dread such alignments.

translations.literal: Offending the front star, the heir apparent has worry.
translations.idiomatic: Striking the anterior star augurs trouble for the heir apparent.

translations.literal: " Third year, first month, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year the emperor died.

translations.literal: The heir was enthroned but in the end was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: The new heir ascended yet was ultimately cast down.

translations.literal: That year, tenth month, jiawu, the moon offended Winnowing-Basket.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of that year, on jiawu, the moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The general dies.
translations.idiomatic: The reading predicts a general’s death.

sentences.zh: 」正始元年四月，車騎將軍黃權薨。

translations.literal: " Zhengshi first year, fourth month, Chariots-and-Horses General Huang Quan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first Zhengshi year General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died.

sentences.zh: 其閏十一月癸丑，月犯心中央大星。

translations.literal: That intercalary eleventh month, guichou, the moon offended Heart’s central great star.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month, on guichou, the moon transgressed the central great star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 少帝正始元年四月戊午，月犯昴東頭第一星。

translations.literal: Young Emperor Zhengshi first year, fourth month, wuwu, the moon offended the first eastern star of Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Zhengshi year of the young emperor, fourth month, wuwu, the moon transgressed the leading eastern star of the Hairy Head cluster.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅，月又犯昴北斗四星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, gengyin, the moon again offended Hairy Head and the fourth star of Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengyin, the moon again transgressed the Pleiades region and the fourth star of the Northern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "When the moon offends Hairy Head, the Hu are not settled.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar hit on Hairy Head unsettles the northern frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 」二年六月，鮮卑阿妙兒等寇西方，敦煌太守王延破之，斬二萬餘級。

translations.literal: " Second year, sixth month, Xianbei under Amiao’er and others raided the west; Dunhuang Prefect Wang Yan defeated them, beheading more than twenty thousand ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year Xianbei bands led by Amiao’er struck westward; Prefect of Dunhuang Wang Yan routed them, taking over twenty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 三年，又斬鮮卑大師及千餘級。

translations.literal: Third year, again beheaded the Xianbei grand shaman and more than a thousand ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year another campaign slew the Xianbei grand shaman and over a thousand others.

sentences.zh: 二年九月癸酉，月犯輿鬼西北星。

translations.literal: Second year, ninth month, guiyou, the moon offended Ghost’s northwest star.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year, on guiyou, the moon transgressed the northwest star of Ghost.

sentences.zh: 三年二月丁未，又犯西南星。

translations.literal: Third year, second month, dingwei, again offended the southwest star.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year’s second month, on dingwei, it again transgressed the southwest star of Ghost.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "There is a money edict.
translations.idiomatic: One reading speaks of a monetary ordinance or cash distribution.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "Great ministers have worry.
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss still warns of anxiety for senior ministers.

translations.literal: " Third year, third month, Grand Commandant Man Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year Grand Commandant Man Chong died.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，帝加元服，賜群臣錢各有差。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, the emperor assumed the capped-age rite and bestowed cash on the various ministers in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year the emperor came of age ceremonially and granted sums of money to officials in graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 四年十月、十一月，月再犯井鉞。

translations.literal: Fourth year, tenth and eleventh months, the moon twice offended Well’s axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth and eleventh months of the fourth year the moon twice transgressed the Well axe-star.

sentences.zh: 是月，宣帝討諸葛恪，恪棄城走。

translations.literal: That month the Lord of Xuan campaigned against Zhuge Ke; Ke abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: That same month the Lord of Xuan attacked Zhuge Ke, who fled abandoning his city.

translations.literal: Fifth year, second month, Cao Shuang campaigned against Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year Cao Shuang invaded Shu.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月癸巳，填星犯亢距星。

translations.literal: Fifth year, eleventh month, guisi, Station Star offended Neck’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year, on guisi, Saturn transgressed the separation star of the Neck mansion.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Among the feudal lords there are those who lose their state.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss foretells feudal lords stripped of their domains.

translations.literal: " Seventh year, seventh month, dingchou, the moon offended the left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year, on dingchou, the moon transgressed the left Horn star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下有兵，左將軍死。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Under Heaven there are weapons; the left general dies.
translations.idiomatic: It predicts war across the realm and death for a general of the left.

translations.literal: " Seventh month, yihai, Sparkling Deluder offended Net’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yihai, Mars transgressed the separation star of Net.

translations.literal: The prognostication says;
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication text continues:

translations.literal: "There is border weapons.
translations.idiomatic: "Border warfare will erupt.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "Punishments are applied.
translations.idiomatic: A variant reading adds widespread use of criminal justice.

translations.literal: " Ninth year, first month, xinhai, the moon offended Neck’s southern star.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, on xinhai, the moon transgressed the southern star of Neck.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Weapons arise.
translations.idiomatic: The omen signals the outbreak of arms.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "The general dies.
translations.idiomatic: Another line again predicts a commander’s death.

translations.literal: " Seventh month, guichou, Station Star offended Key-and-Bar.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guichou, Saturn transgressed Key-and-Bar.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者不宜出宮下殿。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The king ought not go out from palace or descend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The king is warned not to leave the palace or descend the main hall.

sentences.zh: 」嘉平元年，天子謁陵，宣帝奏誅曹爽等。

translations.literal: " Jiaping first year, the Son of Heaven visited the tombs; the Lord of Xuan memorialized to execute Cao Shuang and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Jiaping year the emperor performed tomb rites while the Lord of Xuan secured an order to execute Cao Shuang’s faction.

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven lodged in the field; thereby he lost power.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was forced to encamp abroad and thereafter forfeited real authority.

sentences.zh: 嘉平元年六月壬戌，太白犯東井距星。

translations.literal: Jiaping first year, sixth month, renxu, Great White offended Eastern Well’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first Jiaping year, on renxu, Venus transgressed the separation star of Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The state loses governance; great ministers make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The text foretells misrule at court and ministerial revolt.

translations.literal: " Fourth month, xinsi, Great White offended Ghost Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinsi, Venus transgressed the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Great ministers are beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Senior ministers face execution.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "Weapons arise.
translations.idiomatic: An alternate reading again predicts war.

sentences.zh: 」二年三月己未，太白又犯井距星。

translations.literal: " Second year, third month, jiwei, Great White again offended Well’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, on jiwei, Venus again transgressed the Well separation star.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，王淩與楚王彪有謀，皆伏誅，人主遂卑。

translations.literal: Third year, seventh month, Wang Ling and Prince Biao of Chu plotted; all were executed; the human lord thereafter was humbled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year Wang Ling and Cao Biao, Prince of Chu, were exposed and executed, greatly diminishing the throne’s stature.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權赤烏十三年夏五月，日北至，熒惑逆行，入南斗。

translations.literal: Wu: Sun Quan, Red Crow thirteenth year, summer, fifth month, sun reached northernmost; Sparkling Deluder retrograded and entered Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In Wu, the thirteenth Red Crow year, the summer fifth month at the summer solstice, Mars turned retrograde and entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，犯魁第三星而東。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, it offended the third star of the Dipper’s ladle then moved east.
translations.idiomatic: By autumn’s seventh month it transgressed the third star of the dipper’s bowl and proceeded eastward.

translations.literal: The "Han-Jin Spring and Autumn" says "retrograde motion."
translations.idiomatic: Han-Jin Spring and Autumn explicitly labels the motion as retrograde.

sentences.zh: 案占：「熒惑入南斗，三月吳王死。

translations.literal: Investigating the prognostication: "When Sparkling Deluder enters Southern Dipper, within three months the Wu king dies.
translations.idiomatic: Compiled lore states that Mars in the Southern Dipper foretells the Wu ruler’s death within three months.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "When Sparkling Deluder retrogrades, that region has a dead lord.
translations.idiomatic: Retrograde Mars over a territory likewise augurs a ruler’s death.

sentences.zh: 」太元二年，權薨，是其應也，故《國志》書于吳。

translations.literal: " Taikang second year, Quan died; this matched it, therefore the "National Records" place the entry under Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Quan died in the second Taikang year, matching the omen, so the National Records assign the observation to Wu.

sentences.zh: 是時，王淩謀立楚王彪，謂「斗中有星，當有暴貴者」，以問知星人浩詳。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Ling plotted to enthrone Prince Biao of Chu, saying, "There is a star in the Dipper—surely someone will rise to sudden eminence," and questioned the star-knower Hao Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ling, scheming to elevate Prince Biao, cited an unusual star in the Dipper as a sign of sudden greatness and consulted Hao Xiang.

sentences.zh: 詳疑有故，欲悅其意，不言吳有死喪，而言「淮南楚分，吳楚同占，當有王者興」，故淩計遂定。

translations.literal: Xiang suspected hidden motives and, wishing to please him, did not speak of Wu’s mourning but said, "Huainan is Chu allotment; Wu and Chu share the same reading—there ought to be a king who rises," so Ling’s plan firmed.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Xiang, doubting Wang Ling’s purpose, avoided predicting Wu’s bereavement and instead claimed Huainan’s Chu sector meant a new king would arise, which hardened Ling’s resolve.

sentences.zh: 嘉平二年十二月丙申，月犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Jiaping second year, twelfth month, bingshen, the moon offended Ghost Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second Jiaping year, on bingshen, the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 三年四月戊寅，月犯東井。

translations.literal: Third year, fourth month, wuyin, the moon offended Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year, on wuyin, the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiayin, the moon offended Neck’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin, the moon transgressed Neck’s separation star.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The general dies.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss again predicts a commander’s death.

translations.literal: " One gloss says, "There will be arms.
translations.idiomatic: Another reading simply foretells warfare.

translations.literal: " That month Wang Ling, Prince Biao of Chu, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Ling, Prince Biao, and their confederates were put to death.

translations.literal: Seventh month, Empress Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Empress Zhen died.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，吳將為寇，鎮東將軍諸葛誕破走之。

translations.literal: Fourth year, third month, Wu generals raided; Area Commander East Zhuge Dan routed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year Wu commanders invaded; General Who Guards the East Zhuge Dan drove them off.

sentences.zh: 其年七月己巳，月犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: That year, seventh month, jisi, the moon offended Ghost Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year, on jisi, the moon transgressed Ghost.

translations.literal: Ninth month, yisi, again offended it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yisi, it transgressed Ghost again.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，熒惑犯亢南星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guiwei, Sparkling Deluder offended Neck’s southern star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guiwei, Mars transgressed Neck’s southern star.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Ministers have rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The text warns of mutiny among ministers.

sentences.zh: 」四年十一月丁未，月又犯鬼積尸。

translations.literal: " Fourth year, eleventh month, dingwei, the moon again offended Ghost’s piled corpses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on dingwei, the moon again transgressed the heaped-corpse cluster in Ghost.

sentences.zh: 五年六月戊午，太白犯角。

translations.literal: Fifth year, sixth month, wuwu, Great White offended Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, on wuwu, Venus transgressed the Horn mansion.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The various ministers plot but do not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers intrigue yet fail to carry a coup through.

translations.literal: " Gengchen, the moon offended Winnowing-Basket star.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the moon transgressed a star in Winnowing-Basket.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The general dies.
translations.idiomatic: Another death omen for generals follows.

translations.literal: " Seventh month, the moon offended Well’s axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the moon transgressed the Well axe-star.

translations.literal: Bingwu, the moon again offended Ghost’s northwest star.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the moon again transgressed Ghost’s northwest star.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The state has worry.
translations.idiomatic: The state faces grave concern.

translations.literal: " Eleventh month, guiyou, the moon offended Eastern Well’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, the moon transgressed Eastern Well’s separation star.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The general dies.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss again predicts a general’s death.

sentences.zh: 」正元元年正月，鎮東將軍毋丘儉、揚州刺史文欽反，兵俱敗，誅死。

translations.literal: " Zhengyuan first year, first month, Area Commander East Guanqiu Jian and Inspector of Yang Province Wen Qin rebelled; both hosts were defeated and they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first Zhengyuan year General Who Guards the East Guanqiu Jian and Inspector of Yang Province Wen Qin rose in revolt, lost their armies, and were executed.

sentences.zh: 二月，李豐及弟翼、後父張緝等謀亂，事泄，悉誅，皇后張氏廢。

translations.literal: Second month, Li Feng, his brother Yi, the empress’s father Zhang Ji, and others plotted rebellion; the affair leaked; all were executed; Empress Zhang was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Li Feng, Li Yi, Empress Zhang’s father Zhang Ji, and others conspired; exposed, they were slain and Empress Zhang was cast aside.

translations.literal: Ninth month, the emperor was deposed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor was demoted to Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 蜀將姜維攻隴西，車騎將軍郭淮討破之。

translations.literal: Shu general Jiang Wei attacked Longxi; Chariots-and-Horses General Guo Huai campaigned and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Shu’s Jiang Wei struck Longxi; General of Chariots and Cavalry Guo Huai repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 高貴鄉公正元二年二月戊午，熒惑犯東井北轅西頭第一星。

translations.literal: Duke of Gaoxiang, Zhengyuan second year, second month, wuwu, Sparkling Deluder offended the first western star at the northern yoke-head of Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the second Zhengyuan year of the Duke of Gaoxiang, second month, wuwu, Mars transgressed the leading western star on the northern yoke of Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 甘露元年七月乙卯，熒惑犯東井鉞星。

translations.literal: Ganlu first year, seventh month, yimao, Sparkling Deluder offended Eastern Well’s axe-star.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Ganlu year, seventh month, on yimao, Mars transgressed the Well axe-star.

translations.literal: Renxu, the moon again offended the axe-star.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the moon again transgressed the axe-star.

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinhai, the moon offended Winnowing-Basket.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, the moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket.

sentences.zh: 吳廢孫亮太平元年九月壬辰，太白犯南斗，《吳志》所書也。

translations.literal: Wu deposed Sun Liang: Taiping first year, ninth month, renchen, Great White offended Southern Dipper, as the Wu Annals record.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu deposed Sun Liang, in the first Taiping year’s ninth month, on renchen, Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper—the entry appears in the Wu Annals.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白犯斗，國有兵，大臣有反者。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "When Great White offends the Dipper, the state has weapons; great ministers have rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Venus striking the Dipper presages war and treason among great ministers.

translations.literal: " The next year Zhuge Dan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Zhuge Dan rose in rebellion.

translations.literal: Again the next year Sun Chen deposed Liang.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that Sun Chen removed Sun Liang.

translations.literal: Wu and Wei together had military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Both Wu and Wei saw major campaigning.

sentences.zh: 甘露元年九月丁巳，月犯東井。

translations.literal: Ganlu first year, ninth month, dingsi, the moon offended Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Ganlu year’s ninth month, on dingsi, the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 二年六月己酉，月犯心中央大星。

translations.literal: Second year, sixth month, jiyou, the moon offended Heart’s central great star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year, on jiyou, the moon transgressed Heart’s central great star.

translations.literal: Eighth month, renzi, the Year Star offended Well’s axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi, Jupiter transgressed the Well axe-star.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，歲星逆行，乘井鉞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengyin, the Year Star retrograded, riding atop Well’s axe.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin, Jupiter moved retrograde across the Well axe-star.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，太白犯亢距星。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingyin, Great White offended Neck’s separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingyin, Venus transgressed Neck’s separation star.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Rebellious ministers make chaos; the human lord worries.
translations.idiomatic: Rebellious subjects stir turmoil and the ruler faces anxiety.

sentences.zh: 」景元元年五月，有成濟之變及諸葛誕誅，皆其應也。

translations.literal: " Jingyuan first year, fifth month, the Cheng Ji incident and Zhuge Dan’s execution—all were its correspondences.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first Jingyuan year the Cheng Ji coup and Zhuge Dan’s liquidation fulfilled these omens.

sentences.zh: 二年三月庚子，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: Second year, third month, gengzi, Great White offended Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, on gengzi, Venus transgressed Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The state loses governance; great ministers make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The same gloss of misrule and ministerial revolt applies.

translations.literal: " That night, the Year Star again offended Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: That same night Jupiter again transgressed Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Weapons arise.
translations.idiomatic: The reading again signals war.

translations.literal: " Reaching Jingyuan first year, the Duke of Gaoxiang was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: By the first Jingyuan year the Duke of Gaoxiang had been overthrown.

sentences.zh: 三年八月壬辰，歲星犯輿鬼鑕星。

translations.literal: Third year, eighth month, renchen, the Year Star offended Ghost’s execution-blade star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year, on renchen, Jupiter transgressed the execution-blade star in Ghost.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Axes and execution-blades are used; great ministers are beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Capital punishment falls on high officials when this star is struck.

sentences.zh: 」四年四月甲申，歲星又犯輿鬼東南星。

translations.literal: " Fourth year, fourth month, jiashen, the Year Star again offended Ghost’s southeast star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, on jiashen, Jupiter again transgressed Ghost’s southeast star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「鬼東南星主兵，木入鬼，大臣誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Ghost’s southeast star governs weapons; when wood enters Ghost, great ministers are beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast star of Ghost rules military affairs; Jupiter entering Ghost beheads ministers.

translations.literal: " Jingyuan first year, they killed Minister Wang Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Jingyuan year Minister Wang Jing was executed.

sentences.zh: 元帝景元元年二月，月犯建星。

translations.literal: Prince of Wei, Jingyuan first year, second month, the moon offended Establishment Stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first Jingyuan year of the Wei prince, the moon transgressed the Establishment asterism.

sentences.zh: 案占：「月五星犯建星，大臣相譖。

translations.literal: Investigating the prognostication: "When the moon or five planets offend Establishment Stars, great ministers slander one another.
translations.idiomatic: Compiled lore states that lunar or planetary hits on the Establishment stars pit chief ministers against each other through slander.

translations.literal: " Afterward Zhong Hui and Deng Ai destroyed Shu; Hui slandered Ai.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhong Hui and Deng Ai conquered Shu, whereupon Hui denounced Ai.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。

translations.literal: Second year, fourth month, Sparkling Deluder entered Taiwei and offended the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year Mars entered the Supreme Palace enclosure and transgressed the Right Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "The human lord has great worry.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler faces supreme peril.

translations.literal: " One version says, "Great ministers worry.
translations.idiomatic: Another manuscript reads anxiety for great ministers instead.

translations.literal: " Fourth year, tenth month, the Year Star guarded Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year Jupiter stationed at Chamber.

translations.literal: The prognostication says, "Generals and chancellors worry.
translations.idiomatic: Generals and chancellors face danger.

translations.literal: " One version says, "There is a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: An alternate gloss promises a sweeping pardon.

sentences.zh: 」明年，鄧艾、鍾會皆夷滅，赦蜀土。

translations.literal: " Next year Deng Ai and Zhong Hui were both exterminated and Shu territory was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Deng Ai and Zhong Hui were annihilated and the Shu lands received clemency.

translations.literal: Fifth year, the emperor yielded the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the emperor abdicated.

sentences.zh: 武帝咸寧四年九月，太白當見不見。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu, Xianning fourth year, ninth month, Great White ought to have appeared but did not appear.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth Xianning year of Emperor Wu, Venus should have been visible but failed to appear.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「是謂失舍，不有破軍，必有亡國。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "This is called losing its lodge; if not the destruction of an army, there must be the perishing of a state."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss calls it a "lost station" omen: expect either annihilation in the field or outright dynastic collapse.

translations.literal: At this time Yang Hu submitted a memorial requesting to campaign against Wu; the sovereign approved it.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hu then petitioned for the conquest of Wu, and the throne gave its assent.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月，兵出，太白始夕見西方。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year the army set out; the Great White first appeared in the west at evening.
translations.idiomatic: That November the host marched; Venus made its first evening appearance in the western sky.

sentences.zh: 太康元年三月，大破吳軍，孫皓面縛請罪，吳國遂亡。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Taikang the Wu army was greatly defeated; Sun Hao bound himself with cord and begged guilt; the state of Wu thereupon perished.
translations.idiomatic: In Taikang 1 (280), third month, Wu’s armies were shattered, Sun Hao surrendered in bonds, and the Wu kingdom ceased to exist.

sentences.zh: 太康八年三月，熒惑守心。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year of Taikang Spark-Delusion guarded the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In Taikang 8 (287), third month, Mars stationed in the Heart constellation.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The king abominates it."
translations.idiomatic: The canon again warned the sovereign of mortal ill.

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Taixi, on yiyou, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the fourth month of Taixi 1 (290) the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 惠帝元康三年四月，熒惑守太微六十日。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Yuankang of Emperor Hui, Spark-Delusion guarded the Supreme Palace Enclosure for sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Hui’s Yuankang 3 (293), fourth month, Mars lingered inside the Supreme Palace Enclosure for sixty days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「諸侯三公謀其上，必有斬臣。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The feudal lords and the three dukes plot against their superior; there must be a beheaded minister."
translations.idiomatic: It foretold high nobles scheming against the throne and a minister dying by the axe.

translations.literal: One reading says: "The Son of Heaven loses the state."
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss warned of outright loss of the realm.

translations.literal: That spring the Great White guarded Net, reaching this point for more than a hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: All spring Venus had stationed in the Net asterism—well over a hundred days by then.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There is anxiety about urgent edicts."
translations.idiomatic: It portended frantic emergency decrees from the palace.

translations.literal: One reading says: "The minister of state dies."
translations.idiomatic: A variant reading singled out the chief minister’s death.

translations.literal: Also it means the borderlands are not at peace.
translations.idiomatic: The same configuration augured trouble along the frontiers.

translations.literal: Afterward Empress Jia framed and killed the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Empress Jia engineered the crown prince’s murder.

sentences.zh: 六年十月乙未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, tenth month, on yiwei, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the tenth month of Yuankang 6 Venus appeared in broad daylight.

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year Spark-Delusion guarded the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year’s sixth month Mars again stationed in the Heart.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The king abominates it."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign was again marked for calamity.

translations.literal: In the eighth month Spark-Delusion entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Mars moved into the Feathered Forest guard asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The forbidden troops rise on a great scale."
translations.idiomatic: It foretold palace armies mobilizing en masse.

sentences.zh: 」其後，帝見廢為太上皇，俄而三王起兵討趙王倫，倫悉遣中軍兵相距累月。

translations.literal: After this the emperor was seen deposed as supreme emperor; shortly the three princes raised troops to punish Prince Zhao of Zhao, Lun, who thereupon dispatched all the central army troops to oppose them for successive months.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was soon demoted to retired emperor; then the three princes rose against Prince Sima Lun of Zhao, who threw every central-garrison regiment into months of stalemate.

sentences.zh: 永康元年三月，中台星坼，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Yongkang the middle terrace star split, and the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongkang 1’s third month a Central Court star fractured while Venus shone by day.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "When terrace stars lose their norm, the three dukes have anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: A fractured terrace star boded ill for the three excellencies.

translations.literal: The Great White seen in daytime means unfilial ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight Venus signals treasonous subjects.

sentences.zh: 」是月，賈后殺太子，趙王倫尋廢殺後，斬司空張華。

translations.literal: In that month Empress Jia killed the heir apparent; Prince Zhao of Zhao, Lun, soon deposed and killed the empress and beheaded Minister of Works Zhang Hua.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Empress Jia murdered the crown prince; Sima Lun then toppled and slew the empress and executed Zhang Hua, Minister of Works.

translations.literal: In that fifth month Spark-Delusion entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That May Mars entered the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The minister of state dies; troops rise on a great scale."
translations.idiomatic: The omen promised a chief minister’s death and major war.

translations.literal: The Dipper is also the field division of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper also marks Wu’s celestial territory.

sentences.zh: 」是時，趙王倫為相，明年，篡位，三王興師誅之。

translations.literal: At this time Prince Zhao of Zhao, Lun, was minister; the next year he usurped the throne; the three princes raised armies and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Lun was then chief minister; the following year he seized the throne, only for the three princes’ coalition to crush him.

translations.literal: In the second year of Taian, Shi Bing destroyed Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Taian 2 (303) Shi Bing overran Yangzhou.

translations.literal: In that eighth month Spark-Delusion entered the Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: That August Mars crossed the Winnowing Basket.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The lord of men loses his position; troops rise."
translations.idiomatic: It foretold dethronement and rebellion.

translations.literal: The next year Prince Zhao of Zhao, Lun, usurped the throne and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Sima Lun usurped the throne and proclaimed a new era.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，太白出西方，逆行入東井。

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, the Great White emerged in the west and retrograded into the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongning 2 Venus rose in the west and backed into the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state loses good government; great ministers make rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: Misrule and ministerial revolt were again portended.

sentences.zh: 」是時，齊王冏起兵討趙王倫，倫滅，冏擁兵不朝，專權淫奢，明年，誅死。

translations.literal: At this time Prince of Qi, Jiong, raised troops to punish Prince Zhao of Zhao, Lun; Lun was destroyed; Jiong held troops and did not attend court, monopolized power and indulged in extravagance; the next year he was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Sima Jiong of Qi marched against Sima Lun, destroyed him, then quartered his army in the capital, grew insolent and overbearing, and was executed the following year.

sentences.zh: 永甯元年，自正月至於閏月，五星互經天，縱橫無常。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongning, from the first month through the intercalary month, the five planets in turn crossed the sky, moving erratically without pattern.
translations.idiomatic: From New Year through the leap month of Yongning 1 (301) all five planets in turn transited in broad daylight, weaving unpredictably across the zenith.

translations.literal: The *Star Treatise* states: "The sun is yang, the way of the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: The *Star Canon* explains: the sun embodies yang—the ruler’s path;

translations.literal: stars are yin, the way of ministers."
translations.idiomatic: stars embody yin—the ministers’ path."

sentences.zh: 日出則星亡，臣不得專也。

translations.literal: When the sun comes out then the stars perish; ministers may not monopolize power.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun rises the stars vanish, for subjects must not eclipse their sovereign.

sentences.zh: 晝而星見午上者為經天，其占為不臣，為更王。

translations.literal: When stars are seen at noon they are called crossing the sky; their prognostication is unfilial ministers and change of king."
translations.idiomatic: Stars visible at noon count as "crossing the sky," portending treason and dynastic turnover."

sentences.zh: 」今五星悉經天，天變所未有也。

translations.literal: Now the five planets all crossed the sky—an astral anomaly never before recorded."
translations.idiomatic: Never had all five planets crossed the meridian by day—an omen without precedent in the annals."

sentences.zh: 石氏說曰：「辰星晝見，其國不亡則大亂。

translations.literal: Shi’s explanation states: "When the Chronograph Star is seen in daytime, that state will not perish then there is great chaos."
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shen’s school warns that Mercury by day means either ruin or utter turmoil.

sentences.zh: 」是後，台鼎方伯，互執大權，二帝流亡，遂至六夷更王，迭據華夏，亦載籍所未有也。

translations.literal: After this, terrace ministers and regional shepherds in turn seized great power; the two emperors went into exile; thereupon the six barbarians in succession became kings, each in turn occupying Huaxia—also something never recorded in the canons."
translations.idiomatic: Terrace secretaries and provincial governors then wrested real authority; two emperors fled the capital; steppe peoples took turns enthroning themselves across the North—another novelty unlisted in older star lore."

translations.literal: In that fourth month the Year Star was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: That April Jupiter shone in daylight.

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In May Venus appeared by day.

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as before.
translations.idiomatic: The same omen readings applied as earlier.

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Year Star guarded Emptiness and Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: In July Jupiter stationed between Emptiness and Rooftop.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "When wood guards Emptiness and Rooftop, there is military anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter lingering there augurs war and worry.

translations.literal: Emptiness and Rooftop are the field division of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: That sector maps onto the old Qi heartland.

translations.literal: One reading says: "Guarding Emptiness means famine;
translations.idiomatic: One gloss adds: a long stay over Emptiness promises famine;

translations.literal: guarding Rooftop means corvée labor is excessive and the lower folk are exhausted."
translations.idiomatic: over Rooftop it means crushing levies and a drained populace."

sentences.zh: 」辰星入太微，占曰「為內亂」，一曰「群臣相殺」。

translations.literal: The Chronograph Star entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure; the prognostication states "there is internal disorder," one reading says "the host of ministers kill one another."
translations.idiomatic: Mercury in the Supreme Palace Enclosure reads as palace turmoil—or ministers turning blades on one another."

sentences.zh: 太白守右掖門，占曰：「為兵，為亂，為賊。

translations.literal: The Great White guarded the right Ye Gate; the prognostication states: "There will be troops, there will be chaos, there will be bandits."
translations.idiomatic: Venus guarding the right palace gate foretells arms, riot, and brigandage."

sentences.zh: 」八月戊午，填星犯左執法，又犯上相，占曰「上相憂」。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuwu, the Filling Star transgressed the Left Enforcer, and again transgressed the Upper Minister; the prognostication states "the upper minister has anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in August Saturn struck the Left Enforcer and the Upper Minister stars—ill omens for the senior minister."

sentences.zh: 熒惑守昴，占曰「趙魏有災」。

translations.literal: Spark-Delusion guarded Net; the prognostication states "Zhao and Wei have disaster."
translations.idiomatic: Mars stationed in the Net sector boded disaster for Zhao and Wei.

sentences.zh: 辰星守輿鬼，占曰「秦有災」。

translations.literal: The Chronograph Star guarded the Coach-and-Ghosts; the prognostication states "Qin has disaster."
translations.idiomatic: Mercury lingering on the Ghosts predicted calamity in the old Qin region.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingwei, the moon transgressed the left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the ninth month the Moon crossed the eastern Horn star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The lord of men has anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign was warned of personal peril.

translations.literal: One reading says: "The general of the left guard dies; under Heaven there are troops."
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss added the death of the Left Guard general and nationwide war.

translations.literal: In the second year, fourth month, on guiyou, the Year Star was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fourth month of Yongning 2 Jupiter appeared in daylight.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Ministers are strong."
translations.idiomatic: It warned that subjects would overpower their ruler.

sentences.zh: 」初，齊王冏定京都，因留輔政，遂專慠無君。

translations.literal: Earlier, Prince of Qi, Jiong, had pacified the capital and therefore remained to assist the government, whereupon he monopolized arrogance and had no ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Sima Jiong had rescued Luoyang and stayed on as regent, growing insolent and treating the emperor as a cipher.

sentences.zh: 是月，成都、河間檄長沙王乂討之，冏乂交戰，攻焚宮闕，冏兵敗，夷滅。

translations.literal: In that month Chengdu and Hejian issued proclamations summoning Prince of Changsha, Yi, to campaign against him; Jiong and Yi fought, attacking and burning palace gates; Jiong’s army was defeated and exterminated root and branch.
translations.idiomatic: That month the princes of Chengdu and Hejian called on Sima Yi of Changsha to attack Jiong; their armies clashed, torched the palaces, and annihilated Jiong’s host.

sentences.zh: 又殺其兄上軍將軍寔以下二十餘人。

translations.literal: They also killed his elder brother the Upper Army general Shi and more than twenty others below him.
translations.idiomatic: They slew his elder brother Sima Shi, Upper Army general, and over twenty of his kin and lieutenants.

sentences.zh: 太安二年，成都攻長沙，於是公私饑困，百姓力屈。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taian, Chengdu attacked Changsha; thereby public and private suffered hunger and exhaustion; the common people’s strength was bent.
translations.idiomatic: In Taian 2 the Prince of Chengdu besieged the Prince of Changsha, plunging court and countryside into famine and utter exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 太安二年二月，太白入昴。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Taian the Great White entered Net.
translations.idiomatic: In Taian 2’s second month Venus entered the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven is disturbed; troops rise on a great scale."
translations.idiomatic: The realm would convulse in great war.

translations.literal: In the seventh month Spark-Delusion entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In July Mars entered the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Troops rise; the state is in chaos."
translations.idiomatic: Arms and civil disorder were portended.

translations.literal: That autumn the Great White guarded the Supreme Minister in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Venus stationed on the Supreme Palace’s Supreme Minister star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The supreme minister perishes by arms."
translations.idiomatic: It foretold the chief minister’s death in fighting.

translations.literal: That winter Chengdu and Hejian attacked Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the armies of Chengdu and Hejian struck toward Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 八月，長沙王奉帝出距二王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Prince of Changsha led the emperor out to oppose the two princes.
translations.idiomatic: In August Sima Yi of Changsha marched the sovereign out to face the allied princes.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，東海王越執長沙王乂，張方又殺之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Prince of the East Sea, Yue, seized Prince of Changsha, Yi, and Zhang Fang again killed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year’s first month Sima Yue of the East Sea captured Sima Yi of Changsha, whereupon Zhang Fang put him to death.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，熒惑入南斗，占同永康。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Spark-Delusion entered the Southern Dipper; the prognostication is the same as Yongkang.
translations.idiomatic: That same January Mars re-entered the Southern Dipper—the Yongkang omen applied again.

sentences.zh: 七月，左衛將軍陳眕率眾奉帝伐成都，六軍敗績，兵逼乘輿。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Left Guard general Chen Zhen led the host in attendance on the emperor to campaign against Chengdu; the six armies were utterly defeated; troops pressed the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In July Left Guard commander Chen Zhen escorted the emperor against the Prince of Chengdu; the six hosts were routed and rebels closed on the imperial train.

sentences.zh: 是時，天下盜賊群起，張昌尤盛。

translations.literal: At this time bandits and rebels under Heaven rose in swarms; Zhang Chang was especially flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels sprang up everywhere, Zhang Chang’s horde foremost among them.

sentences.zh: 永興元年七月庚申，太白犯角、亢，經房、心，歷尾、箕。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Yongxing, on gengshen, the Great White transgressed Horn and Neck, passing through Room and Heart, traversing Tail and Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in Yongxing 1’s seventh month Venus cut through Horn, Neck, Room, Heart, Tail, and the Winnowing Basket in succession.

translations.literal: In the ninth month it entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: By September it had entered the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Transgressing Horn means great war under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: The gloss reads: a Horn transit means empire-wide battle;

translations.literal: transgressing Neck means there is great arms; the lord of men has anxiety;
translations.idiomatic: a Neck hit signals massed armies and the ruler’s fear;

translations.literal: entering Room and Heart means arms and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: Room and Heart entries mean war and imperial mourning;

translations.literal: transgressing Tail and Winnowing Basket means the mistress of the harem has anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: Tail and Winnowing Basket transits target the empress."

translations.literal: One reading says: "Under Heaven there is great chaos."
translations.idiomatic: Another line simply predicted universal turmoil.

translations.literal: Entering the Southern Dipper means arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: Entry into the Dipper again augured war and mourning."

translations.literal: One reading says: "The general makes rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: A further gloss warned of a mutinous commander.

sentences.zh: 其所犯守，又兗、豫、幽、冀、揚州之分野。

translations.literal: The places it transgressed and guarded are again the field divisions of Yan, Yu, You, Ji, and Yang provinces."
translations.idiomatic: The stars it touched mapped onto Yan, Yu, You, Ji, and Yangzhou—exactly where armies now raged."

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year there was the battle of Dangyin.
translations.idiomatic: That July saw the slaughter at Dangyin.

sentences.zh: 九月，王浚殺幽州刺史和演，攻鄴，鄴潰，於是兗豫為天下兵衝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Wang Jun killed the Inspector of Youzhou, He Yan, attacked Ye, Ye fell; thereby Yan and Yu became the crossroads of armies under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In September Wang Jun murdered Youzhou Inspector He Yan, stormed Ye, and took the city, turning Yan and Yu into the war-torn heart of the empire.

translations.literal: Chen Min again threw the Yang region into rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Min then ravaged the lower Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 劉元海、石勒、李雄等並起微賤，跨有州郡。

translations.literal: Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Li Xiong and others together rose from humble status and straddled provinces and commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Li Xiong, and other upstarts from the margins carved out provincial empires.

translations.literal: Empress Yang was repeatedly imprisoned and deposed.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Yang suffered repeated deposition and house arrest.

translations.literal: All were its verifications.
translations.idiomatic: Each event matched the omens.

sentences.zh: 二年四月丙子，太白犯狼星。

translations.literal: In the second year, fourth month, on bingzi, the Great White transgressed the Wolf star.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the fourth month of Yongxing 2 Venus crossed the Wolf star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great troops rise."
translations.idiomatic: Major mobilization was foretold.

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Year Star guarded the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In September Jupiter stationed in the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There are troops; the Well is again the field division of Qin."
translations.idiomatic: War was portended, and the Well sector still marks the old Qin lands."

sentences.zh: 」是年，苟晞破公師籓，張方破范陽王猇，關西諸將攻河間王顒，顒奔走，東海王迎殺之。

translations.literal: That year Gou Xi destroyed Gongshi Fan, Zhang Fang defeated Prince of Fanyang, Xiao, the generals of Guanxi attacked Prince of Hejian, Yong, Yong fled in haste, and the Prince of the East Sea came to meet and kill him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gou Xi broke Gongshi Fan, Zhang Fang routed Sima Xiao of Fanyang, Guanxi generals drove Sima Yong of Hejian to flight, and Sima Yue of the East Sea intercepted and slew him.

sentences.zh: 光熙元年四月，太白失行，自翼入尾、箕。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Guangxi the Great White lost its course, going from Wings into Tail and Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxi 1’s fourth month Venus wandered off course, sliding from the Wings mansion through Tail into the Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白失行而北，是謂反生。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Venus lost its course and went north; this is called 'returning to life.'"
translations.idiomatic: The omen reads: when Venus strays northward, it is termed a reversal of fortune—an ill omen of resurgent violence.

translations.literal: If there is not the destruction of an army, there must be the slaughter of a city.
translations.idiomatic: Either a field army will be shattered or a city will be put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 」五月，汲桑攻鄴，魏郡太守馮嵩出戰，大敗，桑遂害東燕王騰，殺萬餘人，焚燒魏時宮室皆盡。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month, Ji Sang attacked Ye; Feng Song, the Administrator of Wei Commandery, went out to battle and was greatly defeated; Sang thereupon harmed Prince Teng of Eastern Yan, killed more than ten thousand persons, and burned the palace chambers of the Wei era until all were exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Ji Sang struck Ye. Wei’s prefect Feng Song rode out to meet him and was routed. Ji Sang then killed Prince Teng of Eastern Yan, massacred over ten thousand people, and razed the old Wei palaces to ash.

translations.literal: In that year’s ninth month, day dingwei, Mars guarded the Heart [asterism].
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the ninth month that year, Mars stationed itself in the Heart.

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The king abhors it."
translations.idiomatic: The omen warns that the sovereign should dread this sign.

translations.literal: " On day jihai, Saturn guarded Fang and the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Saturn stood fixed in Fang and the Heart.

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When Saturn guards Fang, there is much misfortune and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: The text says Saturn lingering in Fang foretells repeated calamity and bereavement;

translations.literal: when it guards the Heart, there is internal disorder in the state, and the realm is granted amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: when it halts in the Heart, civil strife follows and a general pardon sweeps the empire."

sentences.zh: 」是時，司馬越專權，終以無禮破滅，內亂之應也。

translations.literal: " At this time Sima Yue monopolized power; in the end, because of lack of propriety, he was destroyed and extinguished—this was the correspondence to internal disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yue had seized the government and, for his arrogance and breach of ritual, was eventually ruined—exactly the domestic turmoil the stars had portended.

sentences.zh: 十一月，帝崩，懷帝即位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the emperor collapsed; Emperor Huai ascended the throne and greatly pardoned all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor died that November; Huai succeeded and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 懷帝永嘉元年十二月丁亥，星流震散。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day dinghai, first year of Yongjia of Emperor Huai, stars flowed and shook apart.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the twelfth month of Huai’s Yongjia 1, meteors streaked and burst in showers.

sentences.zh: 按劉向說，天官列宿，在位之象；

translations.literal: According to Liu Xiang’s explanation, the arrayed lodges of the celestial offices are images of those holding office;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiang held that the major constellations mirror men in high position;

sentences.zh: 其眾小星無名者，眾庶之類。

translations.literal: those many small stars without names are the category of the common multitude.
translations.idiomatic: the nameless lesser stars stand for the common people.

sentences.zh: 此百官眾庶將流散之象也。

translations.literal: This is the image that the hundred officials and the common multitude are about to flow and scatter.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the sky foretold the dispersal of officials and populace alike.

sentences.zh: 是後天下大亂，百官萬姓，流移轉死矣。

translations.literal: After this, all under Heaven was greatly disordered; the hundred officials and the myriad surnames drifted, moved, turned, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the realm descended into chaos; countless officials and families were uprooted and perished on the road.

sentences.zh: 二年正月庚午，太白伏不見，二月庚子，始晨見東方，是謂當見不見，占同上條。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month, day gengwu, Venus lay hidden and was not seen; in the second month, day gengzi, it first at dawn was seen in the east—this is called ‘ought to be seen yet not seen’; the prognostication is the same as the preceding article.
translations.idiomatic: In year two, Venus vanished on gengwu of the first month and only reappeared at dawn in the east on gengzi of the second—an ‘invisible when expected’ omen matching the earlier rule.

sentences.zh: 其後破軍殺將，不可勝數，帝崩虜庭，中夏淪覆。

translations.literal: After this, the destruction of armies and the killing of generals were not able to be counted; the emperor collapsed in the barbarian court, and the Central Xia sank and overturned.
translations.idiomatic: There followed uncountable routs and slain commanders; the sovereign died a captive among the nomads, and the heartland fell.

sentences.zh: 三年正月庚子，熒惑犯紫微。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, day gengzi, Mars encroached upon Purple Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the first month of the third year, Mars trespassed into the Purple Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「當有野死之王，又為火燒宮。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a king who dies in the wilds, and moreover there is fire burning the palace."
translations.idiomatic: The omen speaks of a ruler dying away from his capital and of flames consuming the halls.

sentences.zh: 」是時太史令高堂沖奏，乘輿宜遷幸，不然必無洛陽。

translations.literal: " At this time the Director of Astronomy Gao Tang Chong submitted a memorial that the imperial carriage ought to remove to another place of fortune; if not, there would certainly be no Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Court astronomer Gao Tang Chong urged the throne to flee the capital or lose Luoyang entirely.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，劉曜、王彌入京都，焚燒宮廊，執帝歸平陽。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, sixth month, Liu Yao and Wang Mi entered the capital city, burned the palace corridors, seized the emperor, and returned him to Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year Liu Yao and Wang Mi took the capital, set the palace corridors ablaze, seized the sovereign, and marched him back to Pingyang.

translations.literal: In the third year, Saturn long guarded the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Through the third year Saturn lingered in the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「填星所居久者，其國有福。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Where Saturn dwells long, that state has blessing."
translations.idiomatic: The canon says prolonged Saturn residence brings fortune to the land beneath it.

sentences.zh: 」是時，安東將軍、琅邪王始有揚土。

translations.literal: " At this time the General Who Pacifies the East, the Prince of Langye, first had Yangzhou soil.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Prince of Langye, General Who Pacifies the East, was first securing his hold on the Yangzhou region.

sentences.zh: 其年十一月，地動，陳卓以為是地動應也。

translations.literal: In that year’s eleventh month, the earth moved; Chen Zhuo took this to be the correspondence of the earth’s moving.
translations.idiomatic: Earth tremors struck that November; Chen Zhuo read them as the terrestrial echo of the omen.

translations.literal: In the fifth year, tenth month, Mars guarded the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year Mars again stationed itself in the Heart.

sentences.zh: 六年六月丁卯，太白犯太微。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, sixth month, day dingmao, Venus encroached upon Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the sixth month of the sixth year Venus crossed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵入天子庭，王者惡之。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Soldiers enter the Son of Heaven’s courtyard; the king abhors it."
translations.idiomatic: The omen warns of troops in the imperial precincts—a thing every ruler fears.

sentences.zh: 」七月，帝崩於寇庭，天下行服大臨。

translations.literal: " In the seventh month the emperor collapsed in the bandit court; all under Heaven went in mourning and great lamentation.
translations.idiomatic: The following July the sovereign perished in captivity, and the realm went into deep mourning.

sentences.zh: 元帝太興元年七月，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taixing of Emperor Yuan, seventh month, Venus encroached upon the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuan’s Taixing 1, Venus trespassed the Southern Dipper in the seventh month.

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "In Wu and Yue there will be soldiers; great men will worry."
translations.idiomatic: The text predicts war in the southeast and anxiety among the great.

translations.literal: " In the second year, second month, day jiashen, Mars encroached upon Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the second month of the second year Mars entered the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Soldiers arise; noble ministers slaughter one another."
translations.idiomatic: The omen foretells mobilization and mutual slaughter among the elite.

translations.literal: " In the eighth month, day jimao, Venus encroached upon the great star of the Coach-and-Courts [of the Purple Palace].
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the eighth month Venus brushed the great Coach-and-Courts star.

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The rear palace worries."
translations.idiomatic: The wives’ quarters were warned of trouble ahead.

sentences.zh: 」三年五月己戊子，太白入太微，又犯上將星。
