translations.literal: In the third year, fifth month, on the received cyclical day jiwuzi (defective graph), the Great White entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and again transgressed the star of the upper general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year, on the day read as wuzi in corrected almanacs, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and again struck the supreme general star; the stem-branch in the received text is defective.

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "The Son of Heaven himself will lead troops; the upper general is executed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen speaks of the emperor taking the field and a top commander paying with his life.

translations.literal: " In the ninth month, Venus encroached upon the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That September Venus again crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 十月己亥，熒惑在東井，居五諸侯南，踟躕留積三十日。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day jihai, Mars was in Eastern Well, dwelling south of the Five Feudal Lords, hesitating and lingering, staying and accumulating thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: From jihai in the tenth month Mars lingered in the Well south of the Five Feudal Lords, dawdling there a full month.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「熒惑守井二十日以上，大人憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When Mars guards the Well twenty days or more, great men worry."
translations.idiomatic: The canon says Mars tarrying in the Well beyond twenty days alarms the mighty.

translations.literal: When it guards the Five Feudal Lords, among the feudal lords there is one who is executed.
translations.idiomatic: If it halts on the Five Feudal Lords, one regional lord will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」永昌元年三月，王敦率江荊之眾來攻京都，六軍距戰，敗績，人主謝過而已。

translations.literal: " In the third month of first year of Yongchang, Wang Dun led the hosts of Jiang and Jing to come attack the capital city; the Six Armies resisted in battle, were defeated and routed; the human ruler apologized for fault only.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongchang 1 Wang Dun marched the Jing–Jiang armies on the capital; the imperial host was beaten, and the emperor could only offer a humiliating apology.

sentences.zh: 於是殺護軍將軍周顗、尚書令刁協、驃騎將軍戴若思。

translations.literal: Thereupon they killed General Who Guards the Army Zhou Yi, Director of the Secretariat Diao Xie, and General Who Gallops as Swiftly as the [Biao] Cavalry Dai Ruosi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Yi, Diao Xie, and Dai Ruosi—champion general, chief minister, and swift cavalry commander—were then executed.

translations.literal: Moreover, General Who Garrisons the North Liu Wei went out and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wei, General Who Garrisons the North, also fled the court.

sentences.zh: 四月，又殺湘州刺史譙王司馬承、鎮南將軍甘卓。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, moreover they killed the Inspector of Xiangzhou, Prince of Qiao, Sima Cheng, and General Who Garrisons the South Gan Zhuo.
translations.idiomatic: The next month Prince Cheng of Qiao, Xiang’s governor, and southern garrison commander Gan Zhuo were slain as well.

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month the emperor collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor died in the leap twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 明帝太寧三年正月，熒惑逆行，入太微。

translations.literal: In the third year of Emperor Ming’s Taining, first month, Mars went retrograde and entered Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Ming’s Taining 3 Mars backed into the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There are soldiers and mourning; the king abhors it."
translations.idiomatic: The omen promises war, bereavement, and royal dread.

translations.literal: " In the intercalary eighth month the emperor collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the leap eighth month.

sentences.zh: 後二年，蘇峻反，攻焚宮室，太后以憂逼崩，天子幽劫于石頭城，遠近兵亂，至四年乃息。

translations.literal: After two years, Su Jun rebelled, attacked and burned the palace chambers; the Empress Dowager, because of worry and pressure, collapsed; the Son of Heaven was secluded and seized at Stone Fortress City; near and far soldiers were disordered; only in the fourth year did it cease.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Su Jun rose, torched the palaces, and drove the empress dowager to her death; the young sovereign was held hostage at Stone City while fighting raged until it finally subsided in the fourth year.

sentences.zh: 成帝咸和六年正月丙辰，月入南斗。

translations.literal: Emperor Cheng, Xianhe sixth year, first month, day bingchen, moon entered Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Cheng, in the sixth year of Xianhe, on bingchen in the first month, the moon passed into the Southern Dipper asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "There will be troops.
translations.idiomatic: The omen text read: armed conflict would follow.

sentences.zh: 」是月，石勒殺略婁、武進二縣人。

translations.literal: " That month, Shi Le killed and plundered the people of Lou and Wujin, two counties.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Shi Le massacred and looted the populations of Lou and Wujin counties.

sentences.zh: 明年，石勒眾又抄略南沙、海虞。

translations.literal: The next year, Shi Le's host again raided and plundered Nansha and Haiyu.
translations.idiomatic: The year after, his army again swept through Nansha and Haiyu.

translations.literal: In that eleventh month, Mars guarded Stomach and Mao.
translations.idiomatic: That November Mars stationed between the Stomach and Hairy Head lunar lodges.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: Zhao and Wei have troops.
translations.idiomatic: The interpretation warned of war in the Zhao and Wei heartlands.

sentences.zh: 」八年七月，石勒死，石季龍自立。

translations.literal: " The eighth year, seventh month, Shi Le died; Shi Jilong set himself up.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year Shi Le died and Shi Hu (Jilong) seized supreme authority.

sentences.zh: 是時，雖二石僭號，而其強弱常占於昴，不關太微、紫宮也。

translations.literal: At this time, although the two Shi usurped titles, yet their strength and weakness were always prognosticated in Mao, not involving Supreme Subtlety and Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Even while both Shis bore illegitimate royal styles, their waxing and waning were read chiefly from Hairy Head, not from the sovereign asterisms Taiwei and Ziwei.

sentences.zh: 八年三月己巳，月入南斗。

translations.literal: Eighth year, third month, day jisi, moon entered Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year, on jisi, the moon entered Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: Same as the sixth year prognostication.
translations.idiomatic: The reading matched the sixth-year omen for the same phenomenon.

sentences.zh: 其年七月，石勒死，彭彪以譙，石生以長安，郭權以秦州並歸順。

translations.literal: That year seventh month, Shi Le died; Peng Biao with Qiao, Shi Sheng with Chang'an, Guo Quan with Qinzhou, together submitted.
translations.idiomatic: That July, upon Shi Le's death, Peng Biao at Qiao, Shi Sheng at Chang'an, and Guo Quan in Qinzhou all came over to Jin.

sentences.zh: 於是遣督護喬球率眾救彪，彪敗，球退。

translations.literal: Thereupon dispatched Supervising Protector Qiu Qiu leading the host to rescue Biao; Biao was defeated; Qiu retreated.
translations.idiomatic: Jin then sent Supervising Protector Qiu Qiu to relieve Peng Biao; Biao was routed and Qiu pulled back.

sentences.zh: 又，石季龍、石斌攻滅生、權。

translations.literal: Again, Shi Jilong, Shi Bin attacked and extinguished Sheng, Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu and Shi Bin then campaigned against and destroyed Shi Sheng and Guo Quan.

translations.literal: That seventh month, Mars entered Mao.
translations.idiomatic: In that same seventh month Mars entered the Hairy Head lodge.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "The Hu king will die.
translations.idiomatic: The omen declared the death of a northern barbarian ruler.

translations.literal: " One saying: "The Zhao region has troops.
translations.idiomatic: An alternate gloss predicted fighting in the Zhao territories.

sentences.zh: 」是月，石勒死，石季龍多所攻沒。

translations.literal: " That month, Shi Le died; Shi Jilong many places attacked and wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shi Le died, and Shi Hu launched widespread offensives that overran numerous districts.

translations.literal: Eighth month, moon again transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the moon again occulted or brushed Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "The Hu will not be at peace.
translations.idiomatic: The reading warned of unrest among the northern regimes.

sentences.zh: 」九年三月己亥，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: " Ninth year, third month, day jihai, Mars entered Chariot Ghost, transgressed Accumulated Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the third month of the ninth year Mars entered Ghost and crossed the Heap of Corpses cluster.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵在西北，有沒軍死將。

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "Troops in the northwest; there is drowning of armies and death of generals.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss foretold northwestern campaigns with drowned hosts and fallen commanders.

translations.literal: " Sixth month, eighth month, moon again transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: The moon repeated its encroachment on Hairy Head in the sixth and again in the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 是時，石弘雖襲勒位，而石季龍擅威橫暴，十一月廢弘自立，遂幽殺之。

translations.literal: At this time, although Shi Hong inherited Le's position, yet Shi Jilong monopolized might and was violent; eleventh month deposed Hong and set himself up; thereupon imprisoned and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hong had succeeded Shi Le in name, but Shi Hu wielded real power with brutal force; in the eleventh month he deposed Hong, proclaimed himself ruler, then had him confined and murdered.

sentences.zh: 咸康元年二月己亥，太白犯昴。

translations.literal: Xiankang first year, second month, day jihai, Great White transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xiankang, on jihai in the second month, Venus crossed Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "Troops arise; mid-year drought.
translations.idiomatic: The omen paired war with a midsummer drought.

sentences.zh: 」四月，石季龍略騎至歷陽，加司徒王道大司馬，治兵列戍衝要。

translations.literal: " Fourth month, Shi Jilong raiding cavalry reached Liyang; added Minister of Education Wang Dao as Grand Marshal; regulated troops, arrayed garrisons at choke points.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Shi Hu's raiding horsemen pushed to Liyang; Wang Dao was promoted to grand marshal and troops were mobilized to hold the strategic defiles.

translations.literal: At this time, Shi Jilong again besieged Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: About the same time Shi Hu renewed his siege of Xiangyang.

translations.literal: Sixth month, drought.
translations.idiomatic: A severe drought struck in the sixth month.

translations.literal: That year third month, day bingxu, moon entered Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the third month of that year the moon entered Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "The Hu king will die.
translations.idiomatic: The same death-of-barbarian-king gloss was recorded again.

translations.literal: " Eighth month, day wuxu, Mars entered Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eighth month Mars entered the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "If no troops, troops arise;
translations.idiomatic: One branch of the omen read: peace breeds mobilization;

translations.literal: if there are troops, troops cease.
translations.idiomatic: where armies are already in the field, they will instead stand down.

translations.literal: " Eleventh month, moon transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the moon again trespassed on Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 二年正月辛亥，月犯房南第二星。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, day xinhai, moon transgressed the second star south of Room.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the first month of the second year the moon crossed the southern second star of the Room lodge.

translations.literal: Eighth month, moon again transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month saw another lunar approach to Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，太白犯南斗，因晝見。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin, Great White transgressed Southern Dipper, therefore was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the ninth month Venus crossed Southern Dipper and appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「斗為宰相，又揚州分，金犯之，死喪之象。

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "Dipper is the chancellor; also Yangzhou's division; metal transgresses it, image of death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss identified the Dipper with chief ministers and the Yangzhou celestial field; Venus intruding there betokened mortality and lamentation.

translations.literal: Being seen by day means not minister; also means troops and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Daytime visibility implied disloyal ministers and further augured war and bereavement.

sentences.zh: 」其後，石季龍僭稱天王，發眾七萬；

translations.literal: " After this, Shi Jilong usurped the title Heavenly King, raised the host seventy thousand;
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Shi Hu arrogated the style Heavenly King and marched seventy thousand men.

sentences.zh: 四年二月自隴西攻殺段遼於薊，又襲慕容皝於棘城，不克，皝擊破其將麻秋，並虜段遼殺之。

translations.literal: Fourth year, second month, from Longxi attacked and killed Duan Liao at Ji, also raided Murong Huang at Jicheng, did not overcome; Huang struck and defeated his general Ma Qiu, and captured Duan Liao and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year he struck from Longxi, slew Duan Liao at Ji, then struck Murong Huang at Jicheng but failed; Huang routed his general Ma Qiu, took Duan Liao captive, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 三年七月己酉，月犯房上星。

translations.literal: Third year, seventh month, day jiyou, moon transgressed the upper star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the seventh month of the third year the moon crossed the upper star of Room.

sentences.zh: 八月，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Mars entered Chariot Ghost, transgressed Accumulated Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Mars entered Ghost and crossed the Heap of Corpses.

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, moon transgressed Eastern Well's distance star.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the moon impinged on the separator star of Eastern Well.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi, moon transgressed Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the ninth month the moon crossed the Establishment asterism.

sentences.zh: 四年四月己巳，太白晝見，在柳。

translations.literal: Fourth year, fourth month, day jisi, Great White seen by day, in Willow.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the fourth month of the fourth year Venus shone in daylight within the Willow lodge.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "Means troops; means not minister.
translations.idiomatic: The reading cited war and treasonous ministers.

sentences.zh: 」明年，石季龍大寇沔南，於是內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: " Next year, Shi Jilong greatly raided south of the Mian; thereupon inner and outer martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Shi Hu launched a major incursion south of the Han River, and the court declared full civil and military mobilization.

sentences.zh: 其五月戊戌，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: That fifth month, day wuxu, Mars transgressed Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in that fifth month Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer star in Taiwei.

translations.literal: The prognostication said: "Great ministers die; those who hold power worry.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss foretold the death of senior ministers and anxiety for the men at the helm of government.

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the ninth month, Grand White again encroached upon the Right Upholder of the Law.
translations.idiomatic: That ninth month, Venus again transgressed the star Right Law Enforcement.

sentences.zh: 案占：「五星災同，金火尤甚。

translations.literal: Investigating the prognostication texts: "When the Five Planets' calamities coincide, metal and fire are especially severe."
translations.idiomatic: The manuals state: "When multiple of the Five Planets portend disaster at once, Venus and Mars are the gravest."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the eleventh month, day Wuzi, Grand White encroached upon the upper star of Fang (the Room).
translations.idiomatic: On the Wuzi day in the eleventh month, Venus trespassed the upper star of the Room asterism.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The senior minister will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The chief minister faces peril."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the fifth year, fourth month, day Yiwei, the moon encroached upon the separation star of Bi (the Net).
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on Yiwei in the fourth month, the Moon occulted the Net's gap star.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Armies will arise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will break out."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the seventh month, day Jiyou, the moon encroached upon the upper star of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiyou in the seventh month, the Moon trespassed the upper star of the Room.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Generals and ministers will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Generals and ministers are imperiled."

sentences.zh: 」是月庚申，丞相王導薨，庾冰代輔政。

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In that month, day Gengshen, Chancellor Wang Dao died; Yu Bing replaced him in assisting governance.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, on Gengshen, Chancellor Wang Dao died, and Yu Bing took his place at the helm of government.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Grand Commandant Xi Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Grand Commandant Xi Jian passed away.

sentences.zh: 又有沔南邾城之敗，百姓流亡萬餘家。

translations.literal: Moreover there was the defeat at Zhucheng south of the Mian, and more than ten thousand households of common people drifted in exile.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the rout at Zhucheng south of the Han, sending over ten thousand households into flight.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，征西大將軍庾亮薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month, General Who Conquers the West Yu Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year's first month the western commander-in-chief Yu Liang died.

sentences.zh: 六年三月甲辰，熒惑犯太微外將星。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, third month, day Jiachen, Sparking Deluder encroached upon the outer general star of Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiachen in the third month of the sixth year, Mars trespassed the outer general star of Supreme Subtlety.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The senior general will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The senior field commander faces danger."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the fourth month, day Dingchou, Sparking Deluder encroached upon the Right Upholder of the Law.
translations.idiomatic: On Dingchou in the fourth month, Mars transgressed Right Law Enforcement.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Those who hold power will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The ruling ministers are at risk."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the sixth month, day Yihai, the moon encroached upon the central star of Qianniu (the Ox).
translations.idiomatic: On Yihai in the sixth month, the Moon trespassed the central star of the Ox.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The great general will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The commander-in-chief faces misfortune."

sentences.zh: 」是時，尚書今何充為執法，有譴，欲避其咎，明年求為中書令。

translations.literal: [Closing quote] At that time, He Chong, Director of the Secretariat (text reads "present"), was Upholder of the Law; there was blame; wishing to avoid its fault, the next year he sought to become Director of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the time He Chong headed the Secretariat and held the law portfolio; censured, he maneuvered the next year into the Palace Secretariat to escape blame.

sentences.zh: 其四月丙午，太白犯畢距星。

translations.literal: That fourth month, day Bingwu, Grand White encroached upon the separation star of Bi.
translations.idiomatic: That fourth month, on Bingwu, Venus occulted the Net's gap star.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Weapons and leather (war) will arise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War will erupt."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] One version states: "The female ruler will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss adds: "The empress is imperiled."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the sixth month, day Yimao, Grand White encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan (the Chariot Shaft).
translations.idiomatic: On Yimao in the sixth month, Venus trespassed the principal star of the Chariot Shaft.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The female ruler will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The palace mistress faces disaster."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the seventh year, third month, Empress Du died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year's third month Empress Du died.

translations.literal: In the seventh year, third month, day Renwu, the moon encroached upon Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On Renwu in the third month of the seventh year, the Moon trespassed the Room.

translations.literal: In the fourth month, day Jichou, Grand White entered Yugi (the Ghost Wagon).
translations.idiomatic: On Jichou in the fourth month, Venus entered the Ghost Wagon.

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Grand White was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Venus appeared in daytime.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day Xinchou, the moon encroached upon Yugi.
translations.idiomatic: On Xinchou in the eighth month, the Moon trespassed the Ghost Wagon.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，熒惑犯房上第二星。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, sixth month, Sparking Deluder encroached upon the second upper star of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year's sixth month, Mars transgressed the second upper star of the Room.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The junior minister will suffer trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The junior minister faces peril."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the eighth month, day Renyin, the moon encroached upon Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On Renyin in the eighth month, the Moon trespassed the Net.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The lower will violate the upper; weapons and leather will arise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Subjects rebel against superiors and war follows."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the tenth month, the moon again covered the great star of Bi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Moon again occulted the Net's chief star.

translations.literal: The divination was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication matched the foregoing.

sentences.zh: 其建元二年，車騎將軍庾冰薨。

translations.literal: In that Jianyuan second year, General of Chariots and Cavalry Yu Bing died.
translations.idiomatic: That Jianyuan second year saw the death of Yu Bing, general of chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 庾翼大發兵，謀伐石季龍，專制上流，朝廷憚之。

translations.literal: Yu Yi greatly raised troops, plotting to attack Shi Hu; he monopolized the upper reaches; the court feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi mobilized a large force to strike Shi Hu, dominated the middle Yangzi, and alarmed the court.

sentences.zh: 康帝建元元年正月壬午，太白入昴。

translations.literal: In Emperor Kang's Jianyuan first year, first month, day Renwu, Grand White entered Mao (the Hairy Head).
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Kang's Jianyuan era, on Renwu in the first month, Venus entered the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The divination states: "In Zhao territory there will be troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Armies in the Zhao region."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] It also states: "Under Heaven troops will arise."
translations.idiomatic: Another line adds: "Warfare across the realm."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the fourth month, day Yiyou, Grand White was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On Yiyou in the fourth month, Venus showed by day.

sentences.zh: 是年，石季龍殺其子邃，又遣將寇沒狄道，及屯薊東，謀慕容皝。

translations.literal: That year, Shi Hu killed his son Sui, also sent generals to raid and seize Didao, and stationed troops east of Ji, plotting against Murong Huang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shi Hu executed his heir Sui, sent columns to seize Didao, camped east of Ji, and menaced Murong Huang.

translations.literal: In the second year, the Year Star encroached upon Tian Guan (Heaven's Gate).
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Jupiter transgressed Heaven's Gate.

sentences.zh: 安西將軍庾翼與兄冰書曰：「歲星犯天關，占云關梁當分。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West Yu Yi wrote to his elder brother Bing: "The Year Star encroached upon Tian Guan; the divination says passes and bridges ought to divide."
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi, western pacification general, wrote his brother Bing that Jupiter at Heaven's Gate foretold severed passes and bridges.

sentences.zh: 比來江東無他故，江道亦不艱難，而石季龍頻年再閉關，不通信使，此復是天公憒憒，無皁白之徵也。

translations.literal: Recently east of the river there has been no other reason; the river road is also not difficult; yet Shi Hu year after year twice has closed the passes, not communicating envoys; this again is Heaven's Duke muddled, without a sign of black and white."
translations.idiomatic: "East of the Yangzi all has been quiet and the waterway open, yet Shi Hu repeatedly sealed the passes and cut envoys; it is as if Heaven itself were confused and sent no clear sign."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In that intercalary month, day Yiyou, Grand White encroached upon Dou (the Dipper).
translations.idiomatic: That intercalary month, on Yiyou, Venus trespassed the Dipper.

translations.literal: The divination states: "There will be mourning; Under Heaven will receive fiefs and salaries."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Death in high places and empire-wide ennoblements."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the ninth month, the emperor died; the heir apparent was established; a great amnesty was issued; fiefs were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor died, the crown prince succeeded, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and titles were granted.

sentences.zh: 穆帝永和元年正月丁丑，月入畢。

translations.literal: In Emperor Mu's Yonghe first year, first month, day Dingchou, the moon entered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Mu's Yonghe era, on Dingchou in the first month, the Moon entered the Net.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Troops will greatly arise."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Major mobilization."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] Day Wuyin, the moon encroached upon Tian Guan.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuyin the Moon trespassed Heaven's Gate.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有亂臣更天子之法。

translations.literal: The divination states: "There will be rebellious ministers who alter the Son of Heaven's laws."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Rebellious ministers who change the imperial statutes."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the fifth month, day Xinsi, Grand White was seen in daylight, in Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On Xinsi in the fifth month, Venus appeared by day in the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Ministers will be strong; Qin will have troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Powerful ministers and armies in the Qin lands."

sentences.zh: 」六月辛丑，月入太微，犯屏西南星。

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the sixth month, day Xinchou, the moon entered Supreme Subtlety, encroaching upon the screen's southwest star.
translations.idiomatic: On Xinchou in the sixth month, the Moon entered Supreme Subtlety and struck the southwest screen star.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Assistant ministers will have ones dismissed and removed."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Senior aides will be cashiered."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the seventh and eighth months, the moon both times encroached upon Bi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh and eighth months the Moon twice trespassed the Net.

translations.literal: The divination was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss matched the prior entry.

translations.literal: Day Jiwei, the moon encroached upon Yugi.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiwei the Moon trespassed the Ghost Wagon.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Great ministers will suffer execution."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Great ministers face execution."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the ninth month, day Gengxu, the moon again encroached upon Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On Gengxu in the ninth month the Moon again occulted the Net.

translations.literal: At the beginning of that year, Yu Yi was at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Early that year Yu Yi held Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 七月，翼疾將終，輒以子爰之為荊州刺史，代己任。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, as Yi's illness was about to end, he thereupon appointed his son Yuanzhi as Inspector of Jing Province, replacing himself in the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, dying, Yu Yi named his son Yuanzhi Jingzhou inspector to succeed him.

translations.literal: Yuanzhi soon was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanzhi was soon removed.

sentences.zh: 明年，桓溫又輒率眾伐蜀，執李勢，送至京都。

translations.literal: The next year, Huan Wen again thereupon led a host to attack Shu, seized Li Shi, and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Huan Wen marched on Shu, captured Li Shi, and sent him to the capital.

translations.literal: Shu originally was Qin territory.
translations.idiomatic: Shu had been heartland of Qin.

sentences.zh: 二年二月壬子，月犯房上星。

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, day Renzi, the moon encroached upon the upper star of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On Renzi in the second month of the second year, the Moon trespassed the upper Room star.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戎，月又犯房上星。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, day Bingxu (text reads bing-rong), the moon again encroached upon the upper star of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On Bingxu in the fourth month the Moon again struck the upper Room star.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day Renshen, Grand White encroached upon the Left Upholder of the Law.
translations.idiomatic: On Renshen in the eighth month, Venus transgressed Left Law Enforcement.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬午，月犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, day Renwu, the moon encroached upon the fifth star of Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On Renwu in the first month of the third year, the Moon trespassed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The general will die; near ministers will depart."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A general dies and inner-court favorites fall."

sentences.zh: 」五月壬申，月犯南斗第四星，因入魁。

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the fifth month, day Renshen, the moon encroached upon the fourth star of Southern Dipper, thereby entering the Kui (bowl).
translations.idiomatic: On Renshen in the fifth month the Moon hit the Southern Dipper's fourth star and entered the bowl.

translations.literal: The divination states: "There will be troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] One version states: "There will be a great amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss: "A great amnesty."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the sixth month, the moon encroached upon Eastern Well's separation star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Moon occulted the Eastern Well's gap star.

translations.literal: The divination states: "The general will die; the state will have trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "A general's death and national anxiety."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] Day Wuxu (text reads shu-xu), the moon encroached upon the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuxu the Moon trespassed the Five Feudal Lords.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Feudal lords will suffer execution."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Regional lords face execution."

sentences.zh: 」九月庚寅，太白犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the ninth month, day Gengyin, Grand White encroached upon the fifth star of Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On Gengyin in the ninth month, Venus transgressed the Southern Dipper's fifth star.

translations.literal: The divination states: "There will be mourning; there will be troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Mourning and arms."

sentences.zh: 」四年七月丙申，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the fourth year, seventh month, day Bingshen, Grand White encroached upon the Left Upholder of the Law.
translations.idiomatic: On Bingshen in the seventh month of the fourth year, Venus trespassed Left Law Enforcement.

translations.literal: Day Jiayin, the moon encroached upon Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiayin the Moon trespassed the Room.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，月入南斗，犯第二星。

translations.literal: Day Dingsi, the moon entered Southern Dipper, encroaching upon the second star.
translations.idiomatic: On Dingsi the Moon entered the Southern Dipper and struck its second star.

translations.literal: Day Yichou, Grand White encroached upon the Left Upholder of the Law.
translations.idiomatic: On Yichou, Venus transgressed Left Law Enforcement.

translations.literal: The divinations were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Every gloss repeated the entries above.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day Jiachen, the moon encroached upon Kang (the Neck).
translations.idiomatic: On Jiachen in the tenth month the Moon trespassed the Neck.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Troops will arise; the general will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War and a general's death."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the eleventh month, day Wuxu, the moon encroached upon the senior general star.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuxu in the eleventh month the Moon struck the senior general star.

translations.literal: In the third year, sixth month, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: The third year's sixth month brought a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是月，陳逵征壽春，敗而還。

translations.literal: That month, Chen Kui campaigned against Shouchun, was defeated, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chen Kui's Shouchun expedition failed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 七月，氐蜀餘寇反，亂益土。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, remnant bandits of the Di and Shu rebelled, throwing Yi territory into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Di and Shu raiders rose again and threw Shu commanderies into turmoil.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Shi Hu campaigned against Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Shi Hu invaded Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，征北大將軍褚裒卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, General Who Conquers the North Chu Pou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year northern expedition commander Chu Pou died.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，太白入昴，是時，戎晉相侵，趙地連兵尤甚。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, fourth month, Grand White entered Mao; at that time Rong and Jin attacked one another; Zhao territory saw continuous troops especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year's fourth month Venus entered the Hairy Head while barbarians and Jin clashed, with heaviest fighting in the Zhao marches.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Grand White encroached upon Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Venus trespassed the Chariot Shaft.

translations.literal: The divination states: "In Zhao, and as for troops and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Disaster for Zhao: war and death."

translations.literal: [Closing quote] Day Jiayin, the moon encroached upon Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiayin the Moon again trespassed the Room.

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the tenth month, day Jiaxu (text reads jia-wu-xu), the moon encroached upon Kang.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiaxu in the tenth month the Moon trespassed the Neck.

translations.literal: The divination states: "Troops will arise; the general will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "War and a commander's end."

sentences.zh: 」八月，石季龍太子宣殺弟韜，宣亦死。

translations.literal: [Closing quote] In the eighth month, Shi Hu's heir apparent Xuan killed his younger brother Tao; Xuan also died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Shi Hu's heir Shi Xuan murdered his brother Shi Tao and was himself killed.

sentences.zh: 其十一月戊戌，月犯上將星。

translations.literal: In that eleventh month, day Wuxu, the moon transgressed the Upper General star.
translations.idiomatic: That November, on the Wuxu day, the Moon drew too near the star of the senior commander.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，石季龍僭號稱皇帝，尋死。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month: Shi Jilong usurped a title and called himself emperor; soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, Shi Hu seized the imperial style and declared himself emperor, then died not long after.

sentences.zh: 五年四月丁未，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: Fifth year, fourth month, day Dingwei: Taibai transgressed Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year, on Dingwei, Venus trespassed against the Well asterism in the east.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Qin will have soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads that Qin would see armed conflict.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day Wuxu: Taibai transgressed the left horn.
translations.idiomatic: On the Wuxu day of the ninth month, Venus closed on the left horn of the Azure Dragon.

translations.literal: Divination text says: It becomes soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was interpreted as widespread warfare.

translations.literal: Tenth month: the moon transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Moon passed against the Pleiades lodge.

translations.literal: Divination text says: The Hu will have grief; generals will die.
translations.idiomatic: The reading warned of trouble for the steppe peoples and the death of commanders.

translations.literal: That year, eighth month: Chu Pou's northern-campaign troops were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the same year, Chu Pou's northern expedition met disaster.

sentences.zh: 十月，關中二十餘舉兵內附。

translations.literal: Tenth month: within Guanzhong more than twenty raised troops and submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month over twenty uprisings in Guanzhong yielded and came over to the court.

translations.literal: Shi Zun attacked and extinguished Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zun took Nanyang by force.

sentences.zh: 十一月，冉閔殺石遵，又盡殺胡十餘萬人，於是趙魏大亂。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Ran Min killed Shi Zun, also entirely killed Hu more than one hundred thousand persons; thereupon Zhao and Wei great chaos.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Ran Min slew Shi Zun and massacred well over a hundred thousand Hu, throwing Zhao and the heartland into turmoil.

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Chu Pou died.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Pou passed away in the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 八年，劉顯、苻健、慕容雋並僭號。

translations.literal: Eighth year: Liu Xian, Fu Jian, Murong Jun together usurped titles.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Liu Xian, Fu Jian, and Murong Jun each proclaimed illegitimate royal styles.

translations.literal: Yin Hao north-campaigned, met defeat, was seen dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hao's northern campaign collapsed and he was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 六年二月辛酉，月犯心大星。

translations.literal: Sixth year, second month, day Xinyou: the moon transgressed the great star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On Xinyou in the second month of the sixth year, the Moon crossed the chief star of the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大人憂，又豫州分野也。

translations.literal: Divination text says: Great men will have grief; moreover it is Yuzhou field division.
translations.idiomatic: The text foretold sorrow for high dignitaries and pointed to the celestial field of Yuzhou.

translations.literal: Day Dingchou: the moon transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: On Dingchou the Moon impinged on the Room lodge.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Generals and ministers will have grief.
translations.idiomatic: The omen spoke of danger to leading generals and ministers.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day Jichou: moon transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On Jichou in the sixth month the Moon trespassed the Mao cluster.

translations.literal: Divination: same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication matched the preceding gloss.

translations.literal: Day Yiwei: moon transgressed Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On Yiwei the Moon neared the Five Feudal Lords stars.

translations.literal: Divination: same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The same divinatory formula applied again.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，月始出西方，犯左角。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day Renyin: the moon first came out in the west, transgressed left horn.
translations.idiomatic: On Renyin in the seventh month, as the Moon first rose in the west it crossed the left horn.

translations.literal: Divination text says: The grand general will die.
translations.idiomatic: The reading predicted the death of a grand general.

translations.literal: One says: Under heaven there will be soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: An alternate gloss warned of war throughout the realm.

translations.literal: Day Dingwei: moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket.
translations.idiomatic: On Dingwei the Moon closed on the Winnowing-Basket stars.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Generals will die.
translations.idiomatic: The omen indicated a general would perish.

translations.literal: Day Bingyin: Mars transgressed the hatchet star.
translations.idiomatic: On Bingyin Mars drew near the axe-shaped star.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Great ministers will have execution.
translations.idiomatic: The text foretold senior ministers facing capital punishment.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day Xinmao: moon transgressed left horn.
translations.idiomatic: On Xinmao in the eighth month the Moon crossed the left horn.

translations.literal: Taibai was seen by day, in Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Venus appeared in daylight within the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: Moon transgressed Right Law-Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon passed against the right court official star in Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: Divinations together same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Every listed prognostication repeated the earlier ones.

sentences.zh: 是歲，司徒蔡謨免為庶人。

translations.literal: That year: Minister of Education Cai Mo was dismissed and became commoner.
translations.idiomatic: In the same year Minister over the Masses Cai Mo was degraded to commoner status.

translations.literal: Seventh year, second month: Taibai transgressed Mao.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year Venus crossed the Mao asterism.

translations.literal: Divination: same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The divination matched the prior entry.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: Third month, day Yimao: Mars entered Ghost Cart, transgressed Heap Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On Yimao in the third month Mars entered the Ghost asterism and touched the Heap of Corpses.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Noble men will have grief.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss warned of misfortune for persons of high rank.

translations.literal: Fifth month, day Yiwei: Mars transgressed the great star of Coach-and-Thongs.
translations.idiomatic: On Yiwei in the fifth month Mars neared the chief star of the Coach constellation.

translations.literal: Divination text says: The chief lady will have grief.
translations.idiomatic: The reading pointed to trouble for the empress or dowager.

translations.literal: Taibai entered Net mouth, transgressed left thigh.
translations.idiomatic: Venus entered the gap of the Net and crossed its left thigh star.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Generals and ministers will match it.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was said to fall on generals and ministers.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day Yihai: moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket.
translations.idiomatic: On Yihai in the sixth month the Moon crossed the Winnowing-Basket.

translations.literal: Divination text says: The state will have soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The text predicted internal or external war for the dynasty.

translations.literal: Day Bingzi: moon transgressed Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On Bingzi the Moon trespassed the Dipper handle stars.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。

translations.literal: Day Dingchou: Mars entered Supreme Subtlety, transgressed Right Law-Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On Dingchou Mars entered the Forbidden Enclosure and crossed the right court star.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day Gengwu: Taibai transgressed Coach-and-Thongs.
translations.idiomatic: On Gengwu in the eighth month Venus brushed the Coach stars.

translations.literal: Day Wuzi: Taibai transgressed Right Law-Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuzi Venus crossed the right Law-Enforcer.

translations.literal: Divinations all entirely same as above.
translations.idiomatic: All associated prognostications repeated the same formulas.

sentences.zh: 七年，劉顯殺石祗及諸將帥，山東大亂，疾疫死亡。

translations.literal: Seventh year: Liu Xian killed Shi Zhi and various commanders; east of mountains great chaos; pestilence and death.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Liu Xian slew Shi Zhi and many generals; Shandong erupted in disorder with plague and heavy mortality.

sentences.zh: 八年三月戊戌，月犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Eighth year, third month, day Wuxu: moon transgressed great star of Coach.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuxu in the third month of the eighth year the Moon neared the chief Coach star.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，月入南斗，犯第二星。

translations.literal: Day Guichou: moon entered Southern Dipper, transgressed the second star.
translations.idiomatic: On Guichou the Moon entered the Dipper and crossed its second star.

translations.literal: Fifth month: moon transgressed Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Moon impinged on the Heart.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day Guiyou: moon transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: On Guiyou in the sixth month the Moon crossed the Room lodge.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，歲星犯東井距星。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day Renzi: Sui star transgressed Eastern Well distance star.
translations.idiomatic: On Renzi in the seventh month Jupiter passed the separator star of the Well.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Internal chaos; soldiers arise.
translations.idiomatic: The reading warned of civil strife and mobilization.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day Wuxu: Mars entered Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuxu in the eighth month Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Loyal ministers are slaughtered to death.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss foretold loyal ministers being put to the sword.

translations.literal: Day Bingchen: Taibai entered Southern Dipper, transgressed fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: On Bingchen Venus entered the Dipper and crossed its fourth star.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Generals will bring disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The omen warned that commanders would stir revolt.

translations.literal: One says: Chancellor will be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: A variant reading predicted the chief minister would be removed.

sentences.zh: 」九年二月乙巳，月入南斗，犯第三星。

translations.literal: Ninth year, second month, day Yisi: moon entered Southern Dipper, transgressed third star.
translations.idiomatic: On Yisi in the second month of the ninth year the Moon entered the Dipper and crossed the third star.

translations.literal: Third month, day Wuchen: moon transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuchen in the third month the Moon trespassed Room.

sentences.zh: 八月，歲星犯輿鬼東南星。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Sui star transgressed Ghost Cart southeast star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Jupiter crossed the southeastern star of Ghost.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Soldiers arise.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication was simply that arms would rise.

sentences.zh: 」是時，帝幼沖，母后稱制，將相有隙，兵革連起，慕容雋僭號稱燕王，攻伐不休。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor was young-rushing; empress mother held the system; generals and ministers had cracks; armor and leather arose in succession; Murong Jun usurped title and called Yan king; attack and punish without rest.
translations.idiomatic: The throne was held by a child, the empress dowager ruled, factions split the high command, fighting spread without pause, Murong Jun styled himself king of Yan, and campaigns continued endlessly.

sentences.zh: 十年正月乙卯，月蝕昴星。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month, day Yimao: moon ate Mao star.
translations.idiomatic: On Yimao in the first month of the tenth year the Moon occulted a star in Mao.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Zhao and Wei will have soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The text predicted warfare in the Zhao and Wei heartland sectors.

translations.literal: Day Guiyou: Fill star covered the hatchet star.
translations.idiomatic: On Guiyou Saturn passed over and hid the axe star.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Axes and halberds will be used.
translations.idiomatic: The reading pointed to executions and military justice.

translations.literal: Second month, day Jiashen: moon transgressed great star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiashen in the second month the Moon crossed the great Heart star.

translations.literal: Divination text says: The king will hate it.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was deemed ill for the sovereign.

translations.literal: Seventh month, day Gengwu: Taibai seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On Gengwu in the seventh month Venus shone in daylight.

translations.literal: By gnomon degrees pushed, the calamity lies in Qin and Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Shadow-length reckoning placed the disaster in the Qin and Zheng celestial fields.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day Xinyou: Taibai transgressed Left Law-Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On Xinyou in the ninth month Venus crossed the left court star.

sentences.zh: 是時，桓溫擅命，朝臣多見迫脅。

translations.literal: At that time Huan Wen monopolized orders; court ministers many were seen forced.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen dominated policy while numerous officials lived under duress.

sentences.zh: 四月，溫伐苻健，破其嶢柳軍。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Wen campaigned against Fu Jian, broke his Yaoliu army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Huan Wen struck Fu Jian and routed the Yaoliu contingent.

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Murong Ke attacked Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Ke invaded Qi in the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月辛亥，月奄軒轅。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, third month, day Xinhai: moon covered Coach-and-Thongs.
translations.idiomatic: On Xinhai in the third month of the eleventh year the Moon passed over the Coach stars.

translations.literal: Divination: same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication duplicated the earlier gloss.

sentences.zh: 四月庚寅，月犯牛宿南星。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day Gengyin: moon transgressed Ox mansion south star.
translations.idiomatic: On Gengyin in the fourth month the Moon crossed the southern Ox star.

translations.literal: Divination text says: The state will have grief.
translations.idiomatic: The reading augured mourning or crisis for the realm.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day Jiwei: Taibai transgressed Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiwei in the eighth month Venus crossed the Celestial River band.

translations.literal: Divination text says: River ferries will not pass.
translations.idiomatic: The omen warned that major crossings would be blocked.

sentences.zh: 」十二年六月庚子，太白晝見，在東井。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, sixth month, day Gengzi: Taibai seen by day, in Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On Gengzi in the sixth month of the twelfth year Venus appeared by day within the Well.

translations.literal: Divination as above.
translations.idiomatic: The divination matched those already cited.

translations.literal: Day Jiwei: moon transgressed hatchet star.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiwei the Moon drew near the axe star.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day Guiyou: moon covered Establishment star.
translations.idiomatic: On Guiyou in the eighth month the Moon occulted a star of Establishment.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將星。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day Wuyin: Mars entered Supreme Subtlety, transgressed western bastion Upper General star.
translations.idiomatic: On Wuyin in the ninth month Mars entered the Forbidden Enclosure and crossed the western senior commander star.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，熒惑犯太微東蕃上相星。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day Dingchou: Mars transgressed Supreme Subtlety eastern bastion Upper Minister star.
translations.idiomatic: On Dingchou in the eleventh month Mars crossed the eastern chief minister star of the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十二年十一月，齊城陷，執段龕，殺三千餘人。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, eleventh month: Qi city fell; Duan Kan was seized; killed more than three thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year Qi fell, Duan Kan was captured, and over three thousand died.

sentences.zh: 永和三年，鮮卑侵略河、冀。

translations.literal: Yonghe third year: Xianbei raided and invaded He and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yonghe Xianbei forces harried the He and Ji corridors.

sentences.zh: 升平元年，慕容雋遂據臨漳，盡有幽、并、青、冀之地。

translations.literal: Shengping first year: Murong Jun then occupied Linzhang, entirely had You, Bing, Qing, Ji lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shengping Murong Jun seized Linzhang and brought You, Bing, Qing, and Ji under his control.

sentences.zh: 緣河諸將奔散，河津隔絕。

translations.literal: Along-river various generals ran scattered; river ferries were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Riverine commanders fled in disorder and bridges and fords were severed.

translations.literal: At that time power lay in the regional shepherds; the nine circuits crossed blades.
translations.idiomatic: Real authority rested with regional governors while fighting spread across the subcelestial realm.

sentences.zh: 升平元年四月壬子，太白入輿鬼。

translations.literal: Shengping first year, fourth month, day Renzi: Taibai entered Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: On Renzi in the fourth month of Shengping year one Venus entered the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，月奄井南轅西頭第二星。

translations.literal: Day Dinghai: moon covered Well south axle west head second star.
translations.idiomatic: On Dinghai the Moon covered the second star at the western end of the Well's southern shaft.

translations.literal: Divination text says: Qin land will have soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication assigned armed trouble to the Qin field.

translations.literal: One says: Generals will die.
translations.idiomatic: A second reading predicted a general's death.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day Wuxu, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on Wuxu, Venus appeared in broad daylight within the Chariot asterism (Zhěn).

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The same omen gloss was applied as before.

translations.literal: The Chariot is the field allotment of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhěn marks Chu’s celestial field.

translations.literal: On day Renzi, the moon transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Moon crossed the Net (Bi) asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "It is border troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen-text reads: "Foretells frontier warfare."

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day Xinsi, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, Mars drew near the Celestial River.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Fords and ferries are blocked."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss warns of blocked rivers and cut supply lines.

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jupiter transgressed the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Jupiter crossed the House (Fang) mansion.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Yu Province will have calamity."
translations.idiomatic: The text points to disaster in the Yu region.

translations.literal: In that year’s fifth month, Fu Jian killed Fu Sheng and established himself.
translations.idiomatic: That May, Fu Jian slew Fu Sheng and took the throne.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Murong Jun entered and encamped at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Murong Jun marched in and garrisoned Ye.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，豫州刺史謝奕薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, Inspector of Yu Province Xie Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year’s eighth month, Yu provincial inspector Xie Yi passed away.

sentences.zh: 二年二月辛卯，填星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, day Xinmao, Saturn transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the second month of the second year, Saturn crossed the chief star of Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The ruler finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen warns the sovereign of ill portent.

translations.literal: On day Jiawu, the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Moon trespassed against the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day Xinyou, the moon transgressed the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the sixth month the Moon crossed the House mansion.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day Jiwei, the Great White transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiwei, Venus closed on the Weeping star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be great weeping."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss foretells widespread mourning and lamentation.

sentences.zh: 」三年正月壬辰，熒惑犯楗閉星。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, day Renchen, Mars transgressed the Bolt-and-Lock star.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the first month of the third year, Mars crossed the Gate-bolt stars.

translations.literal: Investigating, the prognostication states: "The ruler will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The commentary gloss reads: "The throne faces worry."

translations.literal: In the third month, day Yiyou, Mars retrograded and transgressed the Hook-and-Hasp.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the third month Mars moved retrograde against the Hook-and-Hasp.

translations.literal: Investigating the prognostication: "The king finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen-text says the ruler should dread the sign.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, day Yiyou, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the seventh month Mars again neared the Celestial River.

translations.literal: On day Bingxu, the Great White transgressed the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Venus crossed the Ghost asterism (Yuguǐ).

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Every cited gloss matched the entries above.

sentences.zh: 戊子，月犯牽牛中央大星。

translations.literal: On day Wuzi, the moon transgressed the central great star of the Oxherd.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Moon crossed the central bright star of the Oxherd.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Oxherd is Heaven’s general."
translations.idiomatic: The text identifies the Oxherd as the celestial commander’s seat.

translations.literal: Transgressing the central great star means a general will die.
translations.idiomatic: A strike on its central star portends a field marshal’s death.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day Dingwei, the Great White transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eighth month Venus crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star.

translations.literal: On day Jiazi, the moon transgressed the great star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Moon drew near the chief star of the Net.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "It is border troops."
translations.idiomatic: Again the gloss reads: "Border warfare."

translations.literal: One gloss says: The lower transgresses the upper.
translations.idiomatic: Another line adds: subordinates rise against superiors.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，諸葛恢舟軍入河，敗績。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, Zhuge Hui’s river fleet entered the He and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That October Zhuge Hui’s flotilla pushed up the Yellow River and met disaster.

sentences.zh: 豫州刺史謝萬入潁，眾潰而歸，萬除名。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yu Province Xie Wan entered Ying; the host collapsed and returned; Wan was stripped of name.
translations.idiomatic: Yu inspector Xie Wan marched into Yingzhou, his army routed; he returned in shame and lost his rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月，司徒會稽王以郗曇、謝萬二鎮敗，求自敗，求自貶三等。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Minister of Education and Prince of Kuaiji, because the two commands of Xi Tan and Xie Wan had been defeated, submitted asking to degrade himself three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In November the Prince of Kuaiji, serving as Minister of Education, cited Xi Tan and Xie Wan’s twin defeats and memorialized for a three-grade self-demotion.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，慕容雋死，子暐代立。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Murong Jun died; his son Wei succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: First month of the fourth year: Murong Jun died and his son Murong Wei inherited rule.

sentences.zh: 慕容恪殺其尚書令陽騖等。

translations.literal: Murong Ke killed his Director of the Secretariat Yang Wu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Ke executed Grand Secretary Yang Wu and associates.

sentences.zh: 四年正月乙亥，月犯牽牛中央大星。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month, day Yihai, the moon transgressed the central great star of the Oxherd.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the first month of the fourth year the Moon crossed the Oxherd’s central star.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day Xinhai, Mercury transgressed the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the sixth month Mercury crossed Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The queen consort will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss warns of trouble for the empress.

sentences.zh: 」己未，太白入太微右掖門，從端門出。

translations.literal: On day Jiwei, the Great White entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure’s right Censor Gate and exited by the Portal Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Venus slipped into the Supreme Palace through the right rear gate and left by the front portal.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Nobles lose their power."
translations.idiomatic: It portends great families stripped of influence.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "There will be arms."
translations.idiomatic: Another line adds armed conflict.

translations.literal: It also says: "Exiting the Portal Gate means ministers are not ministerial."
translations.idiomatic: A further gloss says leaving the Portal Gate marks ministers turning disloyal.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day Wushen, the Great White transgressed the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eighth month Venus crossed the Root (Dǐ) stars.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
translations.idiomatic: The realm faces mourning and worry.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，熒惑犯太微西蕃上將星。

translations.literal: On day Bingchen, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure’s western bastion and the star of the senior commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Mars neared the western rampart’s senior commander star in the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，太白入南斗口，犯第四星。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day Renwu, the Great White entered the mouth of the Southern Dipper and transgressed its fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the ninth month Venus entered the Dipper’s mouth and struck its fourth star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為喪，有赦，天下受爵祿。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There is mourning; there is amnesty; the realm receives noble ranks and stipends."
translations.idiomatic: It foretells funerals, a general pardon, and ennoblements across the land.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day Jiayin, Mars transgressed the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the twelfth month Mars crossed the House mansion.

translations.literal: On day Bingyin, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，月犯健閉，占曰：「人君惡之。

translations.literal: On day Gengyin, the moon transgressed the Bolt-and-Lock; the prognostication states: "The ruler finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Moon crossed the Gate-bolt; the gloss warns the sovereign of dread.

sentences.zh: 」五年正月乙巳，填星逆行，犯太微。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, first month, day Yisi, Saturn retrograded and transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the first month of the fifth year Saturn moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day Renyin, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the fifth month the Moon crossed the enclosure.

translations.literal: On day Gengxu, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Moon trespassed against the Establishment asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great ministers plot one another."
translations.idiomatic: High officials are set to intrigue against each other.

translations.literal: At this time Yin Hao’s campaign collapsed and he ended in banishment.
translations.idiomatic: That season Yin Hao’s army was routed and he was eventually removed to the margins.

translations.literal: In that month, day Xinhai, the moon transgressed the Oxherd station.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, on xinhai, the Moon crossed the Oxherd lodge.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
translations.idiomatic: Again the gloss speaks of national mourning.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day Guihai, the moon transgressed the northeast star of the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the sixth month the Moon covered the Root’s northeast star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The grand general will answer for it."
translations.idiomatic: A commander-in-chief will bear the brunt.

translations.literal: In the fifth year, first month, North-of-the-River General Xi Tan died.
translations.idiomatic: First month of the fifth year: North-of-the-River general Xi Tan passed away.

sentences.zh: 五月，帝崩，哀帝立，大赦，賜爵，褚後失勢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the emperor died; Emperor Ai ascended; a great amnesty was proclaimed; noble ranks were granted; Empress Chu lost her influence.
translations.idiomatic: In May the sovereign died, Emperor Ai succeeded, a sweeping pardon was issued, titles were handed out, and Empress Chu was sidelined.

sentences.zh: 七月，慕容恪攻冀州刺史呂護于野王，護奔滎陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Murong Ke attacked Inspector of Ji Province Lu Hu at Yewang; Hu fled to Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In July Murong Ke besieged Ji inspector Lu Hu at Yewang, who bolted toward Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 是時，桓溫以大眾次宛，聞護敗，乃退。

translations.literal: At this time Huan Wen, with a great host halted at Wan, heard of Hu’s defeat and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen had massed troops at Wan; learning of Lu Hu’s rout, he pulled back.

sentences.zh: 五年六月癸酉，月奄氐東北星。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, sixth month, day Guiyou, the moon covered the northeast star of the Root.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fifth year’s sixth month the Moon occulted the Root’s northeast star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The grand general will answer for it."
translations.idiomatic: The omen again targets the commander-in-chief.

translations.literal: On day Yiyou in the ninth month, the moon covered the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the ninth month the Moon occulted the Net.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be border troops."
translations.idiomatic: Foretells frontier armies in motion.

translations.literal: On day Dingwei in the tenth month, the moon transgressed the great star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the tenth month the Moon crossed the Net’s chief star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The lower transgresses the upper."
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates challenge their superiors.

translations.literal: It also says: "There will be border troops."
translations.idiomatic: Another line repeats a border-war warning.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Fan Wang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Fan Wang was cashiered.

sentences.zh: 隆和元年，慕容暐遣將寇河陰。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longhe, Murong Wei sent a general to raid Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: Longhe year one: Murong Wei dispatched troops to strike Heyin.

sentences.zh: 哀帝興寧三年七月庚戌，月犯南斗。

translations.literal: In Emperor Ai’s third Xingning year, seventh month, day Gengxu, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Third Xingning year of Emperor Ai, seventh month, gengxu: the Moon crossed the Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The queen consort will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The empress faces ill portent.

translations.literal: Jupiter transgressed the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter crossed the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The ruler will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign should brace for trouble.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Venus appeared by day in the Neck (Kang).

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亢為朝廷，有兵喪，為臣強。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Neck is the court; there will be arms and mourning; ministers will be strong."
translations.idiomatic: Kang marks the court: expect war, funerals, and overbearing ministers.

translations.literal: In the next year’s fifth month, Empress Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: The following May Empress Yu passed away.

sentences.zh: 海西太和二年正月，太白入昴。

translations.literal: In the first month of Emperor Fei’s second Taihe year, the Great White entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: First month of Taihe two under the deposed emperor: Venus entered the Pleiades lodge.

sentences.zh: 五年，慕容暐為苻堅所滅，又據司、冀、幽、并四州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Murong Wei was destroyed by Fu Jian, who also held Si, Ji, You, and Bing provinces.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth year Murong Wei had fallen to Fu Jian, who controlled Si, Ji, You, and Bing.

sentences.zh: 六年閏月，熒惑守太微端門。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of the sixth year, Mars guarded the Portal Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth year’s leap month saw Mars station at the enclosure’s Portal Gate.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Son of Heaven loses the state."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss reads: the dynasty is lost.

translations.literal: It also says: "Feudal lords and the Three Dukes plot against their ruler."
translations.idiomatic: Another line warns that regional lords and chief ministers scheme against the throne.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "There will be decapitated ministers."
translations.idiomatic: A variant adds executions among senior officials.

translations.literal: On day Xinmao, the moon transgressed the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Moon crossed Antares in the Heart.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The king finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign should dread the sign.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，桓溫廢帝，並奏誅武陵王，簡文不許，溫乃徙之新安，皆臣強之應也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Huan Wen deposed the emperor and also memorialized to execute the Prince of Wuling; Emperor Jianwen forbade it, so Wen banished him to Xin’an; all were responses to strong ministers.
translations.idiomatic: That November Huan Wen dethroned the sovereign and sought the Prince of Wuling’s death; Emperor Jianwen refused, so Wen banished the prince to Xin’an—classic signs of ministerial dominance.

sentences.zh: 簡文咸安元年十二月辛卯，熒惑逆行入太微，二年三月猶不退。

translations.literal: In Emperor Jianwen’s first Xian’an year, twelfth month, day Xinmao, Mars retrograded into the Supreme Palace Enclosure; in the third month of the second year it still had not withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Xian’an one, twelfth month, xinmao: Mars moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace and remained through the third month of year two.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state is not secure; there is grief."
translations.idiomatic: The realm stands unsettled under looming sorrow.

translations.literal: At this time the emperor faced coercion from Huan Wen.
translations.idiomatic: The court lived under Huan Wen’s intimidation.

sentences.zh: 二年五月丁未，太白犯天關。

translations.literal: In the second year, fifth month, day Dingwei, the Great White transgressed the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fifth month of the second year Venus crossed the Celestial Pass.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will arise."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss reads: "Warfare will break out."

translations.literal: Jupiter’s color and form were like the Great White’s.
translations.idiomatic: Observers reported Jupiter’s hue and brilliance matching Venus.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "If advance and retreat match the measure, treachery ceases;
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss reads: "When motion keeps proper measure, villainy subsides;"

translations.literal: if color changes and motion is disorderly, the ruler will have no blessing."
translations.idiomatic: but shifting color and erratic motion leave the sovereign without fortune."

sentences.zh: 歲星于仲夏當細小而不明，此其失常也。

translations.literal: Jupiter in midsummer ought to be small and dim; this was its losing normality.
translations.idiomatic: At midsummer Jupiter should appear faint and small—its bright, Venus-like show was plainly abnormal.

translations.literal: It also meant strong ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The same anomaly further signaled overbearing ministers.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: That June Venus shone by day among the Seven Stars (Sagittarius).

translations.literal: On day Yiyou, the Great White transgressed the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Venus crossed the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss warns of national mourning.

sentences.zh: 」七月，帝崩，桓溫以兵威擅權，將誅王坦之等，內外迫脅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the emperor died; Huan Wen seized power by force of arms and was about to execute Wang Tanzhi and others; inside and outside there was coercion.
translations.idiomatic: In July the sovereign passed away while Huan Wen bullied the court with troops, poised to kill Wang Tanzhi and allies, tightening pressure inside the palace and out.

sentences.zh: 又，庾希入京城，盧悚入宮，並誅滅之。

translations.literal: Moreover, Yu Xi entered the capital city; Lu Song entered the palace; both were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xi marched on the capital and Lu Song burst into the palace; both risings were crushed.

sentences.zh: 孝武甯康元年正月戊申，月奄心大星。

translations.literal: In Emperor Xiaowu’s first Ningkang year, first month, day Wushen, the moon covered the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Ningkang one, first month, wushen: the Moon occulted Antares.

sentences.zh: 案上曰：「災不在王者，則在豫州。

translations.literal: Investigating, the superior gloss states: "If the calamity is not on the king, then it is on Yu Province."
translations.idiomatic: Commentary notes: if the throne escapes harm, Yu region still bears the blow.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "The ruler’s mandate finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: Another line warns the sovereign’s life-omen turns ill.

translations.literal: In the third month, day Bingwu, the moon covered the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the third month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great ministers will grieve; there will be deaths."
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials face mourning and fatalities.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "A general will die."
translations.idiomatic: A variant singles out a field commander’s death.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Huan Wen died.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen died in the seventh month.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day Guisi, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the ninth month Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 是時，女主臨朝，政事多缺。

translations.literal: At this time the empress dowager faced the court; government affairs had many shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: The regent empress held court while administration faltered.

sentences.zh: 二年閏月己未，月奄牽牛南星。

translations.literal: In the second year, intercalary month, day Jiwei, the moon covered the southern star of the Oxherd.
translations.idiomatic: Leap month of year two, jiwei: the Moon occulted the Oxherd’s southern star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The left general will die."
translations.idiomatic: Foretells the death of the left-side commander.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day Jiashen, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Root.
