translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiashen: Venus shone by day in the Root (Dǐ).

translations.literal: The Root is the field allotment of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Dǐ marks Yanzhou’s celestial territory.

sentences.zh: 三年五月丙午，北中郎將王坦之薨。

translations.literal: In the third year, fifth month, day Bingwu, North-of-the-River General Wang Tanzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, fifth month, bingwu: North-of-the-River general Wang Tanzhi passed away.

sentences.zh: 三年六月辛卯，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: In the third year, sixth month, day Xinmao, the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinmao: Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Qin region will have arms."
translations.idiomatic: Foretells warfare in the old Qin heartland.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day Wushen, Mars covered the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wushen: Mars occulted the Left Law Enforcer star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Law enforcers will die."
translations.idiomatic: Judicial officials face execution or death.

translations.literal: In the first Taiyuan year, Fu Jian broke Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan one: Fu Jian conquered Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年十月，尚書令王彪之卒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year, Director of the Secretariat Wang Biaozhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Second year’s tenth month: chief minister Wang Biaozhi died.

sentences.zh: 太元元年四月丙戌，熒惑犯南斗第三星。

translations.literal: In Taiyuan first year, fourth month, day Bingxu, Mars transgressed the third star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan one, fourth month, bingxu: Mars crossed the Dipper’s third star.

translations.literal: On day Bingshen, it again covered the fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Mars also occulted the fourth star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will rise greatly; the central lands will hunger."
translations.idiomatic: Mass mobilization and famine stalk the heartland.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "There will be an amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: Another line allows for a general pardon.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, day Guiyou, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Root.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guiyou: Venus appeared by day in the Root.

translations.literal: The Root is the field allotment of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Again Dǐ ties the sign to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，熒惑犯哭泣星，遂入羽林。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Weeping star, then entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: September: Mars crossed the Weeping star and marched into the Feathered Forest guard asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子有哭泣事，中軍兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Son of Heaven will have weeping affairs; the central army’s troops will rise."
translations.idiomatic: Royal mourning and palace-guard mobilization follow.

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day Jiwei, the moon covered the horn of the Root.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiwei: the Moon occulted the Root’s horn.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven there will be arms."
translations.idiomatic: War spreads across the realm.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "The state will have grief."
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss stresses national mourning.

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, Mars guarded the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, second month: Mars stationed in the Feathered Forest.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Palace-guard troops will rise greatly."
translations.idiomatic: Elite household regiments swell in mutiny or campaign.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day Renwu, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renwu: Venus shone by day in the Horn.

translations.literal: The Horn is the field allotment of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Horn marks Yanzhou’s field.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first Shengping year, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Shengping one, fifth month: a sweeping pardon.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，秦人寇樊、鄧、襄陽、彭城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, Qin raiders struck Fan, Deng, Xiangyang, and Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, eighth month: Former Qin forces hit Fan, Deng, Xiangyang, and Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，襄陽陷，朱序沒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year’s second month, Xiangyang fell and Zhu Xu was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, second month: Xiangyang fell; Zhu Xu was taken.

sentences.zh: 四月，魏興陷，賊聚廣陵、三河，眾五六萬。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Weixing fell; bandits gathered at Guangling and Sanhe, fifty or sixty thousand strong.
translations.idiomatic: April: Weixing collapsed; rebels massed fifty to sixty thousand between Guangling and the Sanhe region.

sentences.zh: 於是諸軍外次沖要，丹陽尹屯衛京都。

translations.literal: Thereupon the various armies encamped outward at choke points, and the governor of Danyang garrisoned the capital approaches.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial columns sealed the passes while the Danyang governor fortified the approaches to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月，兗州刺史謝玄討賊，大破之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Inspector of Yan Province Xie Xuan attacked the bandits and crushed them.
translations.idiomatic: June: Yan inspector Xie Xuan smashed the rebel host.

sentences.zh: 是時，中外連兵，比年荒儉。

translations.literal: At this time inner and outer realms were linked in warfare, year after year of dearth.
translations.idiomatic: Civil war raged on all sides amid successive famines.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月丁巳，太白犯哭星。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, eleventh month, day Dingsi, the Great White transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, eleventh month, dingsi: Venus crossed the Weeping star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Son of Heaven will have weeping affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Royal tears and state funerals were portended.

translations.literal: In the fifth year, seventh month, day Bingzi, Mercury transgressed the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, seventh month, bingzi: Mercury crossed Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The queen consort will answer for it."
translations.idiomatic: The empress bears the omen.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day Guiwei, Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: September, guiwei: Empress Wang passed away.

translations.literal: Sixth year, ninth month, day Bingzi.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, ninth month, bingzi (date anchor).

translations.literal: The Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 七年十一月，太白又晝見，在斗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year, the Great White again was seen in daytime, in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, eleventh month: Venus reappeared by day in the Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Wu will have arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The southeast (Wu lands) faces war and funerals.

sentences.zh: 」八年四月甲子，太白又晝見，在參。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, fourth month, day Jiazi, the Great White again was seen in daytime, in Orion’s Belt.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, fourth month, jiazi: Venus again shone by day in Orion.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Wei will have arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The heartland Wei zone faces battle and bereavement.

sentences.zh: 」是月，桓沖征沔漢，楊亮伐蜀，並拔城略地。

translations.literal: That month, Huan Chong campaigned in the Han River basin and Yang Liang attacked Shu, both seizing cities and taking territory.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Huan Chong drove up the Han while Yang Liang struck Shu; both columns took towns and ground.

sentences.zh: 八月，苻堅自將，號百萬，九月，攻沒壽陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Fu Jian personally commanded, claiming a million; in the ninth month he captured and destroyed Shouyang.
translations.idiomatic: August: Fu Jian took the field at the head of a host styled a million; September saw Shouyang fall.

sentences.zh: 十月，劉牢之破苻堅將梁成，斬之，殺獲萬餘人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Liu Laozhi defeated Fu Jian’s general Liang Cheng, beheaded him, and killed or captured more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: October: Liu Laozhi routed Liang Cheng, Fu Jian’s general, took his head, and piled up over ten thousand casualties and captives.

sentences.zh: 謝玄等又破苻堅于淝水，斬其弟融，堅大眾奔潰。

translations.literal: Xie Xuan and others again defeated Fu Jian at the Fei River, beheaded his younger brother Rong, and Fu Jian’s great host fled in collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Xuan’s coalition broke Fu Jian on the Fei, slew his brother Fu Rong, and scattered the mass army.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，皇太后褚氏崩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year’s sixth month, Empress Dowager Chu died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, June: Empress Dowager Chu died.

sentences.zh: 八月，謝玄出屯彭城，經略中州矣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Xie Xuan marched out and encamped at Pengcheng, planning the central plain.
translations.idiomatic: August: Xie Xuan advanced to garrison Pengcheng, eyeing the Central Plain.

sentences.zh: 九年七月丙戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, seventh month, day Bingxu, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, seventh month, bingxu: Venus by day.

translations.literal: On day Dingsi in the eleventh month, it again was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingsi: another daylight Venus.

sentences.zh: 十年四月乙亥，又晝見於畢昴。

translations.literal: On day Yihai in the tenth year’s fourth month, it again was seen in daytime in the Net and Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, fourth month, yihai: Venus again blazed by day through Bi and the Pleiades.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Wei state will have arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The Wei heartland faces war and death.

sentences.zh: 」是時苻堅大眾奔潰，趙魏連兵相攻，堅為姚萇所殺。

translations.literal: At this time Fu Jian’s great host had scattered; Zhao and Wei linked arms in mutual attack; Fu Jian was killed by Yao Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian’s army had melted away; northern rivals tore at each other until Yao Chang slew Fu Jian.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月戊申，太白晝見，在東井。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, third month, day Wushen, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, third month, wushen: Venus by day in the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms; ministers will be strong."
translations.idiomatic: Qin lands see war and domineering ministers.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, day Jiashen, it again was seen in daytime in the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiashen: daylight Venus in the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms."
translations.idiomatic: Again: warfare in Qin.

sentences.zh: 」時魏、姚萇、苻登連兵，相征不息。

translations.literal: At the time Wei, Yao Chang, and Fu Deng linked arms, campaigning without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, Yao Chang, and Fu Deng kept armies in the field without pause.

translations.literal: On day Jiawu, Jupiter was seen in daytime, in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu: Jupiter shone by day in the Stomach lodge.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Lu will have arms; ministers will be strong."
translations.idiomatic: Lu’s territory faces war; ministers grow overbearing.

sentences.zh: 」十二年，慕容垂寇東阿，翟遼寇河上，姚萇假號安定，苻登自立隴上，呂光竊據涼土。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Murong Chui raided Dong’e, Zhai Liao raided the Yellow River line, Yao Chang assumed a reign title at Anding, Fu Deng set himself up on Long, and Lü Guang seized Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year: Murong Chui struck Dong’e, Zhai Liao harried the He frontier, Yao Chang styled himself at Anding, Fu Deng held Long, and Lü Guang carved out Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月癸卯，太白晝見，在柳。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, sixth month, day Guimao, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year, sixth month, guimao: Venus by day in the Willow.

sentences.zh: 十月庚午，太白晝見，在斗。

translations.literal: On day Gengwu in the tenth month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengwu: daylight Venus in the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月丙戌，又晝見。

translations.literal: On day Bingxu in the thirteenth year’s first month, it again was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year, first month, bingxu: another daylight Venus.

sentences.zh: 十二月，熒惑在角亢，形色猛盛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Mars stood in the Horn and Neck, its color and form fierce and strong.
translations.idiomatic: December: Mars blazed angrily through Horn and Neck.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「熒惑失其常，吏且棄其法，諸侯亂其政。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "When Mars loses its norm, clerks will abandon their laws and feudal lords will disorder their government."
translations.idiomatic: Erratic Mars means collapsing bureaucracy and rebel barons.

sentences.zh: 」自是後，慕容垂、翟遼、姚萇、苻登、慕容永並阻兵爭強。

translations.literal: From this time Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong all blocked roads with arms and vied for supremacy.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong all kept private armies and fought for dominance.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，彭城妖賊又稱號於皇丘，劉牢之破滅之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year, Pengcheng’s occult bandits again proclaimed a title at Huangqiu; Liu Laozhi destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, first month: Pengcheng rebels styled themselves at Huangqiu until Liu Laozhi wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 三月，張道破合鄉，圍泰山，向欽之擊走之。

translations.literal: In the third month, Zhang Dao broke Hexiang, besieged Taishan, and Xiang Qinzhi drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: March: Zhang Dao took Hexiang and ringed Taishan until Xiang Qinzhi repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 是年，翟遼又攻沒滎陽，侵略陳項。

translations.literal: That year Zhai Liao again took Xingyang and raided Chen and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhai Liao seized Xingyang and scourged Chen and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 于時政事多弊，君道陵遲矣。

translations.literal: At that time government had many abuses and the ruler’s way declined.
translations.idiomatic: Administration rotted while royal authority slid.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月乙巳，太白晝見於柳。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, fourth month, day Yisi, the Great White was seen in daytime in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, fourth month, yisi: Venus by day in the Willow.

translations.literal: On day Xinmao in the sixth month, it again was seen in daytime in the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinmao: daylight Venus in the Wings.

translations.literal: On day Bingyin in the ninth month, it again was seen in daytime in the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: September, bingyin: daylight Venus in the Chariot.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Mars entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: December: Mars entered the Feathered Forest.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The glosses matched those cited earlier.

sentences.zh: 十五年，翟遼掠司兗，眾軍累討不克，慕容垂又跨略并、冀等州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Zhai Liao plundered Si and Yan; the massed armies repeatedly campaigned without success; Murong Chui also overran Bing, Ji, and neighboring provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth year: Zhai Liao raided Si and Yan while imperial columns failed to finish him; Murong Chui meanwhile overran Bing and Ji.

translations.literal: In the seventh month there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: July brought drought.

sentences.zh: 八月，諸郡大水，兗州又蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the commanderies suffered great floods, and Yanzhou also had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: August floods swamped the districts and locusts scourged Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月癸未，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, ninth month, day Guiwei, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth year, September, guiwei: Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Great White entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: October: Venus marched into the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月癸卯朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the new moon of day Guimao in the sixteenth year’s fourth month, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteenth year, fourth month, guimao new moon: Venus visible by day.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，月奄心前星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day Guisi, the moon covered the front star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guisi: the Moon occulted the Heart’s forward star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The heir apparent will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss warns of peril to the crown prince.

translations.literal: At this time the crown prince constantly had severe illness.
translations.idiomatic: The heir was chronically and gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 十七年七月丁丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, seventh month, day Dingchou, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth year, seventh month, dingchou: Venus by day.

translations.literal: On day Dingyou in the tenth month, it again was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingyou: another daylight Venus.

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year, it again was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteenth year, sixth month: Venus again shone by day.

sentences.zh: 十九年五月，又晝見於柳。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year, it again was seen in daytime in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteenth year, May: daylight Venus in the Willow.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，又晝見於輿鬼。

translations.literal: On day Xinyou in the sixth month, it again was seen in daytime in the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: June, xinyou: daylight Venus in the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, it again was seen in the Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: September: Venus reappeared in the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 二十年六年，熒惑入天囷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twentieth year, Mars entered the Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth year, sixth month: Mars entered the Celestial Granary (Heaven’s round-silo asterism).

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great famine."
translations.idiomatic: The omen reads: widespread starvation.

translations.literal: On day Dinghai in the seventh month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: July, dinghai: Venus blazed by day inside the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白入太微，國有憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "When the Great White enters the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the state will have grief."
translations.idiomatic: Venus inside the enclosure spells national mourning.

translations.literal: Being seen in daytime means arms and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight appearance adds war and funerals.

sentences.zh: 」十二月己巳，月犯楗閉及東西咸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, day Jisi, the moon transgressed the Gate-bolt and the eastern and western Sincerity stars.
translations.idiomatic: December, jisi: the Moon crossed the Gate-bolt and the east and west Sincerity stars.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「楗閉司心腹喉舌，東西咸主陰謀。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Gate-bolt governs heart, belly, throat, and tongue; the eastern and western Sincerity govern secret plots."
translations.idiomatic: The bolt-stars watch intimates and spokesmen; the Sincerity pair marks hidden intrigue.

sentences.zh: 」二十一年二月壬申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On day Renshen in the second month of the twenty-first year, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-first year, second month, renshen: Venus by day.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，太白連晝見，在羽林。

translations.literal: On day Guimao in the third month, the Great White continuously was seen in daytime, in the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: March, guimao: Venus lingered visible by day in the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有強臣，有兵喪，中軍兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be a strong minister; there will be arms and mourning; central-army troops will rise."
translations.idiomatic: Foretells a domineering minister, battle and bereavement, and palace-army upheaval.

translations.literal: In the third month, the Great White was seen in daytime in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: March: daylight Venus in the Stomach lodge.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Central-army troops will rise."
translations.idiomatic: Household guards mobilize.

translations.literal: On day Renwu in the fourth month, the Great White entered the Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: April, renwu: Venus entered the Celestial Granary.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be famine."
translations.idiomatic: Portends hunger.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Jupiter transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: June: Jupiter crossed the Weeping star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be weeping affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Mourning follows.

translations.literal: In that year’s ninth month, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: That September the sovereign died.

sentences.zh: 隆安元年，王恭等舉兵脅朝廷，於是內外戒嚴，殺王國寶以謝之。

translations.literal: In the first Long’an year, Wang Gong and others raised troops to coerce the court; thereupon inner and outer were placed on alert, and Wang Guobao was killed to appease them.
translations.idiomatic: Long’an one: Wang Gong’s coalition menaced Jiankang; the capital locked down and Wang Guobao was executed as a sop.

sentences.zh: 又連歲水旱，三方動，眾人饑。

translations.literal: Moreover, successive years of flood and drought stirred the three fronts and the masses starved.
translations.idiomatic: Years of weather disaster roiled three war zones while commoners went hungry.

sentences.zh: 安帝隆安元年正月癸亥，熒惑犯哭泣星。

translations.literal: In Emperor An’s first Long’an year, first month, day Guihai, Mars transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: Long’an one, first month, guihai: Mars crossed the Weeping star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be weeping affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Again: royal mourning.

translations.literal: On day Dingchou in the fourth month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: April, dingchou: Venus by day in the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: The northwestern Qin theater faces war and death.

sentences.zh: 」六月，姚興攻洛陽，郗恢遣兵救之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Yao Xing attacked Luoyang; Xi Hui sent troops to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: June: Yao Xing struck Luoyang while Xi Hui dispatched relief.

translations.literal: In winter Yao Chang died; his son Lie succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: Winter: Yao Chang died and his son Yao Xing (Lie) took the throne.

translations.literal: The Prince of Wei, Gui, assumed position at Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Wei prince Tuoba Gui mounted the throne at Zhongshan.

translations.literal: That eighth month, Mars guarded the Well’s battle-axe stars.
translations.idiomatic: That August Mars stationed at the Eastern Well’s axe stars.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great ministers will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials face execution.

sentences.zh: 」二年六月戊辰，攝提移度失常。

translations.literal: In the second year, sixth month, day Wuchen, Sheti moved across degrees abnormally.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, sixth month, wuchen: the Sheti pointer jumped its proper step.

sentences.zh: 歲星晝見，在胃，兗州分野。

translations.literal: Jupiter was seen in daytime, in the Stomach, the field allotment of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter shone by day in the Stomach, Yanzhou’s celestial field.

sentences.zh: 是年六月，郗恢遣鄭啟方等以萬人伐慕容寶於滑臺，敗而還。

translations.literal: In that year’s sixth month, Xi Hui sent Zheng Qifang and others with ten thousand men to attack Murong Bao at Huatai; they were defeated and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That June Xi Hui sent Zheng Qifang’s ten-thousand-man column against Murong Bao at Huatai; it retreated in defeat.

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: Leap month: daylight Venus in the Feathered Forest.

translations.literal: On day Dingchou, the moon transgressed the eastern upper minister.
translations.idiomatic: Dingchou: the Moon crossed the eastern upper minister star.

sentences.zh: 三年五月辛酉，月又奄東上相。

translations.literal: In the third year, fifth month, day Xinyou, the moon again covered the eastern upper minister.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, May, xinyou: the Moon again occulted the eastern upper minister.

translations.literal: On day Xinwei, Mercury transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: Xinwei: Mercury crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The glosses matched prior entries.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，庾楷等舉兵，表誅王愉等，於是內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the second year’s ninth month, Yu Kai and others raised troops, memorializing to execute Wang Yu and others; thereupon inner and outer were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, September: Yu Kai’s faction mobilized to demand Wang Yu’s head; the realm went on war footing.

translations.literal: In the third year’s sixth month, Luoyang fell to bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, June: Luoyang was lost to raiders.

sentences.zh: 桓玄破荊州，雍州殺殷仲堪等。

translations.literal: Huan Xuan broke Jing Province; Yong Province killed Yin Zhongkan and others.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan shattered Jingzhou while Yongzhou forces slew Yin Zhongkan and his circle.

sentences.zh: 孫恩聚眾攻沒會稽，殺內史。

translations.literal: Sun En gathered a host, attacked and took Kuaiji, and killed the interior governor.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En’s rebels seized Kuaiji and executed the governor.

sentences.zh: 四年六月辛酉，月犯哭泣星。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, sixth month, day Xinyou, the moon transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, June, xinyou: the Moon crossed the Weeping star.

translations.literal: In the fifth year, first month, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, first month: Venus by day.

sentences.zh: 自去年十二月在斗晝見，至於是月乙卯。

translations.literal: From the previous year’s twelfth month it had been seen in daytime in the Dipper until this month’s Yimao day.
translations.idiomatic: Since the prior twelfth month Venus had stayed visible by day in the Dipper until yimao of this month.

translations.literal: Investigating the prognostication: "The calamity lies in Wu and Yue."
translations.idiomatic: Commentary places the omen in the Wu-Yue southeast.

translations.literal: On day Guihai in the seventh month, the Great Horn star scattered, trembled, and showed five colors.
translations.idiomatic: July, guihai: Arcturus flickered in polychrome bursts.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The king will be scattered and dispersed."
translations.idiomatic: Portends a sovereign driven from his throne.

translations.literal: On day Dingmao, the moon transgressed the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao: the Moon crossed the Celestial Pass.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The king will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: Royal worry is foretold.

sentences.zh: 」九月庚子，熒惑犯少微，又守之。

translations.literal: On day Gengzi in the ninth month, Mars transgressed Shao Wei and then guarded it.
translations.idiomatic: September, gengzi: Mars crossed Shao Wei and stationed there.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Recluses will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Hermit-scholars face the headsman.

translations.literal: On day Jiazi in the tenth month, the moon transgressed the eastern secondary minister.
translations.idiomatic: October, jiazi: the Moon crossed the eastern secondary minister.

sentences.zh: 其年七月，太皇太后李氏崩。

translations.literal: In that year’s seventh month, Grand Empress Dowager Li died.
translations.idiomatic: That July Grand Empress Dowager Li passed away.

sentences.zh: 十月，妖賊大破高雅之于餘姚，死者十七八。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, occult bandits greatly defeated Gao Yazhi at Yuyao; seven or eight tenths died.
translations.idiomatic: October: rebel sorcerers shattered Gao Yazhi at Yuyao with seventy to eighty percent losses.

sentences.zh: 五年，孫恩攻侵郡縣，殺內史，至京口，進軍蒲洲，於是內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Sun En attacked counties, killed interior governors, reached Jingkou, advanced to Pu Islet, and thereupon inner and outer were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year: Sun En raided commanderies, slew governors, pushed to Jingkou and Pu Islet, and put the capital region on alert.

sentences.zh: 恩遣別將攻廣陵，殺三千餘人，退據郁洲，是時劉裕又追破之。

translations.literal: En sent a separate general to attack Guangling, killing more than three thousand; he withdrew to hold Yuzhou, at which time Liu Yu again pursued and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En’s column hit Guangling, killed three thousand-plus, then fell back to Yuzhou island until Liu Yu chased and crushed them.

sentences.zh: 九月，桓玄表至，逆旨陵上。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Huan Xuan’s memorial arrived, defying the decree and lording over the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: September: Huan Xuan’s arrogant memorial snubbed the throne.

sentences.zh: 十月，司馬元顯大治水軍，將以伐玄。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Sima Yuanxian greatly drilled a river army intending to attack Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: October: Sima Yuanxian mass-trained a fleet to strike Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 元興元年正月，盧循自稱征虜將軍，領孫恩餘眾，略有永嘉、晉安之地。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first Yuanxing year, Lu Xun styled himself General Who Subdues Caitiffs, led the remainder of Sun En’s host, and seized ground in Yongjia and Jin’an.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxing one, first month: Lu Xun claimed the caitiff-subduing generalship, inherited Sun En’s bands, and carved out Yongjia and Jin’an.

translations.literal: In the second month, the emperor in battle dress dispatched the western army.
translations.idiomatic: February: the emperor, in armor, sent the western host.

sentences.zh: 三月，桓玄，克京都，殺司馬元顯，放太傅會稽王道子。

translations.literal: In the third month, Huan Xuan took the capital, killed Sima Yuanxian, and banished Grand Tutor and Prince of Kuaiji, Daozi.
translations.idiomatic: March: Huan Xuan seized Jiankang, executed Sima Yuanxian, and exiled Prince Daozi of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 元興元年三月戊子，太白犯五諸侯，因晝見。

translations.literal: In Yuanxing first year, third month, day Wuzi, the Great White transgressed the Five Feudal Lords and thereby was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxing one, third month, wuzi: Venus crossed the Five Feudal Lords and shone by day.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Feudal lords will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Regional lords face execution.

translations.literal: On day Wuyin in the seventh month, Mars was in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: July, wuyin: Mars stood in the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: Mars transgressed the Ghost Cart and Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossed the Ghost asterism and the corpse-pile stars.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Glosses repeated earlier lines.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，太白奄右執法。

translations.literal: On day Bingyin in the eighth month, the Great White covered the right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: August, bingyin: Venus occulted the right Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Guiwei in the ninth month, the Great White transgressed Advancing Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: September, guiwei: Venus crossed the Advancing Worthy star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Those of Advancing Worthy will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Men tied to the Advancing Worthy star face death.

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, Jupiter transgressed the western upper general.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, February: Jupiter crossed the western upper general.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，月奄斗第四星。

translations.literal: On day Jiachen in the sixth month, the moon covered the fourth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: June, jiachen: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fourth star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great ministers will be executed; within three years."
translations.idiomatic: High ministers die, within three years’ span.

sentences.zh: 」八月癸丑，太白犯房北第二星。

translations.literal: On day Guichou in the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the second northern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: August, guichou: Venus crossed the Chamber’s second north star.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，歲星犯進賢，熒惑犯西上將。

translations.literal: On day Jichou in the ninth month, Jupiter transgressed Advancing Worthy, and Mars transgressed the western upper general.
translations.idiomatic: September, jichou: Jupiter crossed Advancing Worthy while Mars crossed the western upper general.

translations.literal: On day Jiaxu in the tenth month, the Great White transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: October, jiaxu: Venus crossed the Weeping star.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，熒惑犯東上相。

translations.literal: On day Dingyou in the eleventh month, Mars transgressed the eastern upper minister.
translations.idiomatic: November, dingyou: Mars crossed the eastern upper minister.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，月奄軒轅第二星。

translations.literal: On day Yisi in the twelfth month, the moon covered the second star of the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: December, yisi: the Moon occulted Xuanyuan’s second star.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Omen glosses matched prior citations.

translations.literal: In the first year’s winter, Wei broke Yao Xing’s army.
translations.idiomatic: First year winter: Northern Wei shattered Yao Xing’s host.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月，桓玄篡位，放遷帝、後於尋陽，以永安何皇后為零陵君。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year, Huan Xuan usurped the throne, banished emperor and empress to Xunyang, and made Empress He of Yong’an the Lady of Lingling.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, twelfth month: Huan Xuan seized the throne, exiled the sovereigns to Xunyang, and demoted Empress He to Lady of Lingling.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，劉裕盡誅桓氏。

translations.literal: In the third year’s second month, Liu Yu exterminated the entire Huan clan.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, February: Liu Yu wiped out the Huans.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊戌，熒惑逆行，犯太微西上相。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, day Wuxu, Mars retrograded and transgressed the western upper minister of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, first month, wuxu: Mars moved retrograde against the enclosure’s western upper minister.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子戰于野，上相死。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Son of Heaven battles in the field; the upper minister dies."
translations.idiomatic: Portends a ruler fighting in the open and a chief minister’s death.

sentences.zh: 」二月丙辰，熒惑逆行，在左執法西北。

translations.literal: On day Bingchen in the second month, Mars retrograded, northwest of the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: February, bingchen: Mars hung retrograde northwest of the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Law enforcers will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Judicial stars mark executions.

translations.literal: On day Jiawu in the fourth month, the moon covered the second star of the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: April, jiawu: the Moon occulted Xuanyuan’s second star.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，月奄斗第二星，填星入羽林。

translations.literal: On day Renshen in the fifth month, the moon covered the second star of the Dipper, and Saturn entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: May, renshen: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s second star while Saturn entered the Feathered Forest.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Glosses again matched earlier ones.

sentences.zh: 是年二月丙辰，劉裕殺桓修等。

translations.literal: In that year’s second month, on day Bingchen, Liu Yu killed Huan Xiu and others.
translations.idiomatic: That February, bingchen, Liu Yu slew Huan Xiu and associates.

sentences.zh: 三月己末，破走桓玄，遣軍西討。

translations.literal: In the third month, on day Jiwei, he routed Huan Xuan and sent armies west to pursue him.
translations.idiomatic: March, jiwei: Liu Yu broke Huan Xuan and launched western pursuit columns.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，誅左僕射王愉，桓玄劫天子如江陵。

translations.literal: On day Xinsi, he executed Left Director Wang Yu; Huan Xuan seized the Son of Heaven and went to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi: Wang Yu the left director was beheaded while Huan Xuan abducted the emperor toward Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 五月，玄下至崢嶸洲，義軍破滅之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Xuan came down to Zhengrong Islet and the righteous army destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: May: Huan Xuan descended to Zhengrong Islet where the loyalist host annihilated him.

sentences.zh: 桓振又攻沒江陵，幽劫天子。

translations.literal: Huan Zhen again attacked and took Jiangling, imprisoned and coerced the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Zhen retook Jiangling, holding the emperor captive.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Empress He of Yong’an died.
translations.idiomatic: July: Empress He of Yong’an passed away.

sentences.zh: 義熙元年三月壬辰，月奄左執法。

translations.literal: In Yixi first year, third month, day Renchen, the moon covered the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Yixi one, third month, renchen: the Moon occulted the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The same gloss applied.

translations.literal: On day Dingyou, the moon covered the front star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyou: the Moon occulted the Heart’s forward star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Yu Province will have calamity."
translations.idiomatic: The omen targets Yu region.

translations.literal: The Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms."
translations.idiomatic: Foretells Qin-zone warfare.

translations.literal: On day Gengchen in the seventh month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Wings and Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: July, gengchen: Venus shone by day through Wings and Chariot.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為臣強，荊州有兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Ministers will be strong; Jing Province will have arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: Powerful ministers and Jingzhou war and funerals.

translations.literal: On day Dingsi in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the first star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: August, dingsi: the Moon crossed the Dipper’s first star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven there will be arms."
translations.idiomatic: General war spreads.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "Great ministers will grieve."
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials face sorrow.

translations.literal: On day Jiazi in the ninth month, Mars transgressed Shao Wei.
translations.idiomatic: September, jiazi: Mars crossed Shao Wei.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Recluses will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: Hermit scholars face execution.

translations.literal: On day Gengyin, Mars transgressed the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyin: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Guimao, Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Guimao: Mars crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Glosses matched prior entries.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，太白犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On day Bingxu in the eleventh month, the Great White transgressed the Hook-and-Hasp.
translations.idiomatic: November, bingxu: Venus crossed the Hook-and-Hasp.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Throat-and-tongue will grieve."
translations.idiomatic: Spokesmen and advisors face ruin.

translations.literal: On day Jimao in the twelfth month, Jupiter transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: December, jimao: Jupiter crossed the Celestial River.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be military turmoil; river fords will not be open."
translations.idiomatic: War chaos chokes the waterways.

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Inspector of Jing Province Wei Yongzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: November: Jing inspector Wei Yongzhi passed away.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。

translations.literal: In the second year’s second month, Sima Guofan and others attacked and took Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, February: Sima Guofan’s faction seized Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 四月，姚興伐仇池公楊盛，擊走之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Yao Xing campaigned against Lord of Chouchi Yang Sheng and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: April: Yao Xing struck Yang Sheng of Chouchi and repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 九月，益州刺史司馬榮期為其參軍楊承祖所害。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Inspector of Yi Province Sima Rongqi was killed by his adjutant Yang Chengzu.
translations.idiomatic: September: Yi inspector Sima Rongqi fell to adjutant Yang Chengzu’s blade.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月，司徒揚州刺史王謐薨。

translations.literal: In the third year’s twelfth month, Minister of Education and Yangzhou Inspector Wang Mi died.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, December: Wang Mi, Minister of Education and Yangzhou inspector, died.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，太保武陵王遵薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year’s first month, Grand Guardian and Prince of Wuling, Zun, died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month: Grand Guardian Prince Zun of Wuling died.

translations.literal: In the third month, Left Director Kong Anguo died.
translations.idiomatic: March: Left Director Kong Anguo passed away.

sentences.zh: 自後政在劉裕，人主端拱而已。

translations.literal: From this time government lay with Liu Yu; the ruler merely folded his hands.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward real power sat with Liu Yu while the emperor ruled in name only.

translations.literal: In the second year’s second month, the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, February: Venus crossed the Southern Dipper.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will arise."
translations.idiomatic: War stirs.

translations.literal: On day Jichou, the moon transgressed the rear star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Jichou: the Moon crossed the Heart’s rear star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Yu Province will have calamity."
translations.idiomatic: Yu region again bears the omen.

translations.literal: On day Guichou in the fourth month, the moon transgressed the western upper general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: April, guichou: the Moon crossed the enclosure’s western upper general.

translations.literal: On day Jiwei, the moon transgressed the second southern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s second south star.

translations.literal: On day Yichou, Jupiter transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: Yichou: Jupiter crossed the Celestial River.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be military turmoil; river fords will not be open."
translations.idiomatic: River blockages and mutiny follow.

translations.literal: On day Guiwei in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: May, guiwei: the Moon crossed the Horn’s left star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「左將軍死，天下有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The left general will die; under Heaven there will be arms."
translations.idiomatic: The left commander dies while war engulfs the realm.

translations.literal: On day Renyin, Mars transgressed the Root.
translations.idiomatic: Renyin: Mars crossed the Root.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Root is the lodging palace; the ruler will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The Root as palace seat means the sovereign faces dread.

sentences.zh: 」六月庚午，熒惑犯房北第二星。

translations.literal: On day Gengwu in the sixth month, Mars transgressed the second northern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: June, gengwu: Mars crossed the Chamber’s second north star.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，熒惑犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: On day Guihai in the eighth month, Mars transgressed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: August, guihai: Mars crossed the Dipper’s fifth star.

translations.literal: On day Dingsi, it transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi: Mars crossed the Establishment asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be arms."
translations.idiomatic: Plain war omen.

sentences.zh: 」九月壬午，熒惑犯哭星，又犯泣星。

translations.literal: On day Renwu in the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Weeping star and also transgressed the Sobbing star.
translations.idiomatic: September, renwu: Mars crossed both Weeping and Sobbing stars.

sentences.zh: 是年二月甲戌，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。

translations.literal: In that year’s second month, day Jiaxu, Sima Guofan and others attacked and took Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: That February, jiaxu, Sima Guofan again seized Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 又，慕容超侵略徐、兗，三年正月，又寇北徐州，至下邳。

translations.literal: Moreover, Murong Chao raided Xu and Yan; in the third year’s first month he again raided Northern Xu Province down to Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Chao harried Xu and Yan; third year’s first month he struck Northern Xu as far as Xiapi.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Minister of Education Wang Mi died.
translations.idiomatic: December: Minister Wang Mi died.

translations.literal: In the fourth year’s first month, Prince Zun of Wuling died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month: Prince Zun of Wuling passed away.

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Murong Chao again raided the Huai north.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year: Murong Chao returned to scour the north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 四月，劉裕大軍討之，拔臨朐。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Liu Yu’s great army campaigned against him and took Linqu.
translations.idiomatic: April: Liu Yu’s host took Linqu.

translations.literal: He also besieged Guanggu and took it.
translations.idiomatic: He then ringed and stormed Guanggu.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙子，太白晝見，在奎。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, day Bingzi, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Strider.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, first month, bingzi: Venus by day in the Strider (Kui).

translations.literal: On day Gengshen in the second month, the moon covered the rear star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: February, gengshen: the Moon occulted the Heart’s rear star.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Same gloss as prior Heart omen.

translations.literal: On day Guiwei in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: May, guiwei: the Moon crossed the left Horn.

translations.literal: On day Jichou, the Great White was seen in daytime, in Orion’s Belt.
translations.idiomatic: Jichou: Venus shone by day in Orion’s Belt.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Yi Province will have arms and mourning; ministers will be strong."
translations.idiomatic: Yi region faces war and death while ministers grow bold.

translations.literal: On day Jimao in the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: August, jimao: Venus crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Xinmao, Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Xinmao: Mars crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，熒惑犯進賢星。

translations.literal: On day Renzi in the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Advancing Worthy star.
translations.idiomatic: September, renzi: Mars crossed Advancing Worthy.

sentences.zh: 是年八月，劉敬宣伐蜀，不克而旋。

translations.literal: In that year’s eighth month, Liu Jingxuan campaigned against Shu without success and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That August Liu Jingxuan’s Shu expedition failed and turned back.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，左僕射孔安國卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year’s third month, Left Director Kong Anguo died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, March: Left Director Kong Anguo died.

sentences.zh: 七月，司馬叔璠等攻沒鄒山，魯郡太守徐邕破走之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Sima Shufan and others attacked and took Zou Mountain; Lu commandery governor Xu Yong defeated them and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: July: Sima Shufan seized Zou Mountain until Lu governor Xu Yong routed the band.

sentences.zh: 姚略遣眾征赫連勃勃，大為所破。

translations.literal: Yao Xing sent a host to campaign against Helian Bobo and was greatly defeated by him.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing’s army marched on Helian Bobo and was shattered.

sentences.zh: 五年，劉裕討慕容超，滅之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year: Liu Yu crushed Murong Chao.

sentences.zh: 四年正月庚子，熒惑犯天關。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month, day Gengzi, Mars transgressed the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month, gengzi: Mars crossed the Celestial Pass.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，月奄斗第二星。

translations.literal: On day Dingwei in the fifth month, the moon covered the second star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: May, dingwei: the Moon occulted the Dipper’s second star.

translations.literal: On day Renzi, Saturn transgressed the Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: Renzi: Saturn crossed the Celestial Granary.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven will hunger; granary grain will be little."
translations.idiomatic: Famine empties the state granaries.

sentences.zh: 」六月己丑，太白犯太微西上將。

translations.literal: On day Jichou in the sixth month, the Great White transgressed the western upper general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: June, jichou: Venus crossed the western upper general.

translations.literal: On day Yimao it again transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Yimao: Venus also crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Wuzi in the tenth month, Mars entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: October, wuzi: Mars entered the Feathered Forest.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Glosses repeated earlier citations.

sentences.zh: 五年，劉裕討慕容超，後南北軍旅運轉不息。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao; afterward northern and southern armies shuttled without rest.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year: Liu Yu’s Murong campaign kept north-south logistics in perpetual motion.

translations.literal: In the fifth year, second month, day Jiazi, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, second month, jiazi: the Moon crossed the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「胡不安，天子破匈奴。

translations.idiomatic: Steppe peoples tremble while the court crushes northern raiders.

translations.idiomatic: Jisi: the Moon occulted Antares.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The king finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign should dread the sign.

translations.literal: In that year’s fourth month, Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao.
translations.idiomatic: That April Liu Yu opened the Murong Chao campaign.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Prince of Wei, Gui, met assassination and died.
translations.idiomatic: October: Wei prince Tuoba Gui was murdered.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，盧循逼郊甸，宮衛被甲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year’s fifth month, Lu Xun pressed the suburbs; palace guards donned armor.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, May: Lu Xun threatened the capital outskirts and household troops armed.

sentences.zh: 六年三月丁卯，月奄房南第二星。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, third month, day Dingmao, the moon covered the second southern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, third month, dingmao: the Moon occulted the Chamber’s second south star.

translations.literal: The calamity lies on the secondary minister.
translations.idiomatic: The omen falls on the deputy minister.

translations.literal: On day Jisi, it again covered the fifth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Jisi: the Moon again occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The Dipper governs Wu; Wu lands will have arms arise."
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper ties the sign to Wu and southeast warfare.

translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed the Five Feudal Lords.

translations.idiomatic: Regional lords face execution.

translations.literal: On day Jiazi in the fifth month, the moon covered the fifth star of the Dipper.

translations.literal: On day Jihai, the moon covered the third star of the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Jihai: the Moon occulted the Pleiades’ third star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
translations.idiomatic: National mourning follows.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "There will be a gathering in white."
translations.idiomatic: Another line warns of mass mourning in undyed hemp.

translations.literal: On day Jichou in the sixth month, the moon transgressed the second southern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: June, jichou: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s second south star.

translations.literal: On day Jiawu, the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu: Venus shone by day.

translations.idiomatic: National mourning is foretold.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "Qin will have arms."
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss cites Qin-region warfare.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On day Renwu in the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: August, renwu: Venus crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star.

translations.literal: On day Jiashen, the moon transgressed the front star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen: the Moon crossed the Heart’s forward star.

translations.literal: The calamity lies on Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: The blow falls on Yu region.

translations.literal: On day Bingxu, the moon transgressed the fifth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Bingxu: the Moon crossed the Dipper’s fifth star.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Same gloss as the prior Dipper omen.

translations.literal: On day Dinghai, the moon covered the southern star of the Ox station.
translations.idiomatic: Dinghai: the Moon occulted the Ox lodge’s southern star.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Under Heaven there will be great executions."
translations.idiomatic: Mass executions sweep the realm.

translations.literal: On day Yiwei, the Great White transgressed Shao Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwei: Venus crossed Shao Wei.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白在少微而晝見。

translations.literal: On day Bingwu, the Great White was in Shao Wei and was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Bingwu: Venus stood in Shao Wei yet blazed by day.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On day Jiayin in the ninth month, the Great White transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: September, jiayin: Venus crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Dingchou, Saturn transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Dingchou: Saturn crossed the Net.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be border troops."
translations.idiomatic: Frontier armies mobilize.

sentences.zh: 」是年三月，始興太守徐道覆反。

translations.literal: In that year’s third month, Defender of Shixing Xu Daofu rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That March Shixing governor Xu Daofu rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 四月，盧循寇湘中，沒巴陵，率眾逼京畿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Lu Xun raided the Xiang basin, took Baling, and led his host to press the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: April: Lu Xun scourged Hunan, seized Baling, and drove on the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 是月，左僕射孟昶懼王威不振，仰藥自殺。

translations.literal: That month, Left Director Meng Chang, fearing royal authority was not vigorous, drank poison and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That month Left Director Meng Chang, despairing of the throne’s strength, took poison.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月，劉蕃梟徐道覆首，杜慧度斬盧循，並傳首京都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, Liu Fan displayed Xu Daofu’s head; Du Huidu beheaded Lu Xun; both heads were sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year’s twelfth month: Liu Fan sent up Xu Daofu’s head while Du Huidu slew Lu Xun; both trophies reached Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，劉道規卒，時為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth year’s sixth month, Liu Daogui died; at the time he was Inspector of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, June: Liu Daogui died while serving as Yu inspector.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: August: Empress Wang passed away.

sentences.zh: 九月，兗州刺史劉蕃、尚書左僕射謝混伏誅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Yan Inspector Liu Fan and Left Director Xie Hun were executed in the field.
translations.idiomatic: September: Yan inspector Liu Fan and left director Xie Hun were put to death.

sentences.zh: 劉裕西討劉毅，斬首徇之。

translations.literal: Liu Yu campaigned west against Liu Yi and displayed his severed head.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu’s western column finished Liu Yi and paraded his head.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遣益州刺史朱齡石伐蜀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, he dispatched Yi Inspector Zhu Lingshi to campaign against Shu.
translations.idiomatic: December: Zhu Lingshi was sent to conquer Shu.

sentences.zh: 七年四月辛丑，熒惑入輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, fourth month, day Xinchou, Mars entered the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, fourth month, xinchou: Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms."
translations.idiomatic: Qin lands see war.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "Yong Province will have calamity."
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss targets Yongzhou.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Great White was seen in daytime, in the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: June: Venus shone by day in the Wings.

translations.literal: On day Jihai, Saturn transgressed the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Jihai: Saturn crossed the Celestial Pass.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Ministers will plot against the ruler."
translations.idiomatic: Ministerial treason is portended.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the second southern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: August: Venus crossed the Chamber’s second south star.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，太白犯哭星。

translations.literal: On day Bingzi in the eleventh month, the Great White transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: November, bingzi: Venus crossed the Weeping star.

translations.literal: That seventh month, Zhu Lingshi took Shu.
translations.idiomatic: That July Zhu Lingshi conquered Shu.

translations.literal: Shu rebelled again and was campaigned against and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Shu rose once more and was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 八年七月癸亥，月奄房北第二星。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, seventh month, day Guihai, the moon covered the second northern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, July, guihai: the Moon occulted the Chamber’s second north star.

translations.literal: On day Jiwei, the moon transgressed the Well’s battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei: the Moon crossed the Eastern Well’s axe stars.

translations.literal: On day Wushen in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the Sobbing star.
translations.idiomatic: August, wushen: the Moon crossed the Sobbing star.

translations.literal: On day Xinhai in the tenth month, the moon covered the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: October, xinhai: the Moon occulted the Celestial Pass.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be arms."
translations.idiomatic: War follows.

translations.literal: On day Dingchou in the eleventh month, Saturn transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: November, dingchou: Saturn crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great men will grieve."
translations.idiomatic: High lords face mourning.

translations.literal: On day Guimao in the twelfth month, Saturn transgressed the Well’s battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: December, guimao: Saturn crossed the Well’s axe stars.

translations.literal: In that year’s eighth month, Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: That August Empress Wang died.

sentences.zh: 九月，誅劉蕃、謝混，討滅劉毅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Liu Fan and Xie Hun were executed and Liu Yi was campaigned against and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: September: Liu Fan and Xie Hun were killed while Liu Yi’s faction was crushed.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Zhu Lingshi extinguished Shu.
translations.idiomatic: December: Zhu Lingshi finished the Shu pacification.

translations.literal: In the ninth year’s second month, Mars entered the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, February: Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: War and funerals coincide.

translations.literal: The Great White transgressed the South River.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed the South River stars.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will arise."
translations.idiomatic: War stirs.

sentences.zh: 」五月壬辰，太白犯右執法，晝見。

translations.literal: On day Renchen in the fifth month, the Great White transgressed the Right Law Enforcer and was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: May, renchen: Venus crossed the Right Law Enforcer and shone by day.

translations.literal: On day Gengwu in the seventh month, the moon covered the Hook-and-Hasp.
translations.idiomatic: July, gengwu: the Moon occulted the Hook-and-Hasp.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Throat-and-tongue ministers will grieve."
translations.idiomatic: Court spokesmen face ruin.

translations.literal: On day Gengwu in the ninth month, Jupiter transgressed the great star of the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: September, gengwu: Jupiter crossed Xuanyuan’s chief star.

translations.literal: On day Jichou, the moon transgressed the left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Jichou: the Moon crossed the left Horn.

translations.literal: At the time Liu Yu monopolized commands and arms never rested.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu held unchecked power while wars rolled on.

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Yu campaigned against Sima Xiuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Year ten: Liu Yu struck Sima Xiuzhi.

sentences.zh: 王師不利，休之等奔長安。

translations.literal: The royal army did not prevail; Xiuzhi and others fled to Chang’an.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces lost; Xiuzhi’s party bolted to Chang’an.

translations.literal: In the tenth year, first month, day Dingmao, the moon transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, first month, dingmao: the Moon crossed the Net.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「將相有以象坐罪者。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Generals and ministers will have someone who by the image seat is punished."
translations.idiomatic: High command faces punishment matching the stellar seat.

translations.literal: On day Jiyou in the second month, the moon transgressed the northern star of the Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: February, jiyou: the Moon crossed the Chamber’s north star.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，月犯牽牛南星。

translations.literal: On day Renyin in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the southern star of the Oxherd.
translations.idiomatic: May, renyin: the Moon crossed the Oxherd’s southern star.

translations.idiomatic: June, bingshen: the Moon occulted the Root.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "A general will die for it; the state will have executions."
translations.idiomatic: A commander dies while the court orders killings.

translations.literal: On day Gengchen in the seventh month, the moon transgressed the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: July, gengchen: the Moon crossed the Celestial Pass.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Arms will arise."
translations.idiomatic: War is portended.

translations.literal: Mars transgressed the Well’s battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossed the Well’s axe stars.

translations.literal: Saturn transgressed the Ghost Cart and then guarded it.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn crossed the Ghost asterism and stationed there.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great men will grieve; the ancestral temples will change."
translations.idiomatic: Mourning among magnates and dynastic upheaval.

translations.literal: On day Dingyou in the eighth month, the moon covered the southern star of the Oxherd.
translations.idiomatic: August, dingyou: the Moon occulted the Oxherd’s southern star.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Same gloss as the prior Oxherd omen.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Saturn transgressed the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: September: Saturn crossed the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The ruler will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign faces dread.

translations.literal: On day Dingsi, the Great White entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi: Venus entered the Feathered Forest.

translations.literal: On day Jiyou in the twelfth month, the moon transgressed the western Sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: December, jiyou: the Moon crossed western Sincerity.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be secret plots."
translations.idiomatic: Hidden intrigue spreads.

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Linyi raided Jiaozhou and was resisted and defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Year eleven: Linyi struck Jiaozhou and was beaten back.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月丁巳，月入畢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, third month, day Dingsi, the moon entered the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, March, dingsi: the Moon entered the Net.

translations.idiomatic: Realm-wide war follows.

translations.literal: One gloss says: "There will be border troops."
translations.idiomatic: A variant stresses frontier hosts.

translations.literal: On day Jimao, Mars entered the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: Jimao: Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

translations.idiomatic: Leap month, bingwu: Saturn re-entered the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "There will be drought, great pestilence, and rebellious ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Drought, plague, and treasonous officials follow.

translations.literal: On day Guimao in the fifth month, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: May, guimao: Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: On day Jiachen, it transgressed the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Jiachen: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Jiwei in the sixth month, the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: June, jiwei: Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms."
translations.idiomatic: Qin-zone warfare again.

translations.literal: On day Wuyin, it transgressed the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyin: Venus crossed the Ghost asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Same Root gloss as before.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太白順行，從右掖門入太微。

translations.idiomatic: Gengshen: Venus moved direct into the enclosure through the right rear gate.

translations.literal: On day Dingmao, it covered the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao: Venus occulted the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Guihai in the eleventh month, the moon entered the Net.
translations.idiomatic: November, guihai: the Moon entered the Net.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Same Net entry gloss.

translations.literal: On day Yiwei, the moon entered the Ghost Cart and showed a halo.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwei: the Moon entered the Ghost asterism with a lunar halo.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月甲申，歲星留房心之間，宋之分野。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, fifth month, day Jiashen, Jupiter halted between the Chamber and the Heart, the field allotment of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year, May, jiashen: Jupiter stationed between House and Heart, Song’s celestial field.

translations.literal: Thereupon Liu Yu was first enfeoffed as Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu received his first investiture as Duke of Song.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，太白順行入太微右掖門。

translations.idiomatic: June, renzi: Venus moved direct into the enclosure’s right rear gate.

translations.literal: On day Jisi, the moon transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Jisi: the Moon crossed the Net.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Same Net gloss as before.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the moon transgressed the Ox station.
translations.idiomatic: July: the Moon crossed the Ox lodge.

translations.literal: On day Bingxu in the tenth month, the moon entered the Net.
translations.idiomatic: October, bingxu: the Moon entered the Net.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月丙子，月犯軒轅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, fifth month, day Bingzi, the moon transgressed the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year, May, bingzi: the Moon crossed Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: On day Dinghai, it transgressed the Oxherd.
translations.idiomatic: Dinghai: the Moon crossed the Oxherd.

translations.literal: On day Guisi, Mars transgressed the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi: Mars crossed the Right Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Jiyou in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the Oxherd.
translations.idiomatic: August, jiyou: the Moon crossed the Oxherd.

translations.literal: On day Dingmao, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The ruler will be anxious."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign faces ill portent.

translations.literal: On day Renchen in the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: September, renchen: Mars crossed Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: On day Wushen in the tenth month, the moon transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: October, wushen: the Moon crossed the Net.

translations.literal: The prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Glosses matched prior entries.

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon crossed the Winnowing Basket (Ji).

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "The state will have grief."
translations.idiomatic: National mourning follows.

translations.literal: On day Jiayin, the moon transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayin: the Moon crossed the Net.

translations.literal: The prognostication was the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Same Net omen again.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，填星犯太微，留積七十餘日。

translations.literal: On day Yimao, Saturn transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure and halted, accumulating more than seventy days.
translations.idiomatic: Yimao: Saturn crossed the enclosure and lingered over seventy days.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Warning of a lost ruler."
translations.idiomatic: A lost-ruler omen is recorded.

translations.literal: On day Renxu, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Renxu: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 十四年三月癸巳，太白犯五諸侯。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, third month, day Guisi, the Great White transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, March, guisi: Venus crossed the Five Feudal Lords.

translations.literal: On day Gengzi in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: May, gengzi: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: On day Jiachen in the seventh month, Mars transgressed the Ghost Cart.
translations.idiomatic: July, jiachen: Mars crossed the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「秦有兵，又為旱，為兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Qin will have arms; moreover drought; moreover arms and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: Qin lands face war, drought, and battlefield death.

sentences.zh: 」亦曰：「大人憂，宗廟改，亦為亂臣。

translations.literal: It also says: "Great men will grieve; the ancestral temples will change; moreover there will be rebellious ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Magnates mourn, dynastic temples shift, and traitorous ministers appear.

sentences.zh: 」時劉裕擅命，軍旅數興，饑旱相屬，其後卒移晉室。

translations.literal: At the time Liu Yu monopolized commands, armies rose repeatedly, famine and drought followed one another, and afterward he finally moved the Jin house.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu held absolute power, campaigns and dearth came in waves, and he ultimately transferred the Jin mandate.

translations.literal: On day Dingsi, the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi: the Moon crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "An army general will die."
translations.idiomatic: A field commander will perish.

translations.literal: On day Jiazi in the eighth month, the Great White transgressed the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: August, jiazi: Venus crossed Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，填星入太微，犯右執法，因留太微中，積二百餘日乃去。

translations.literal: On day Guiyou, Saturn entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, transgressed the Right Law Enforcer, and therefore stayed inside the Supreme Palace Enclosure, accumulating more than two hundred days before departing.
translations.idiomatic: Guiyou: Saturn entered the enclosure, crossed the Right Law Enforcer, and lingered inside over two hundred days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「填星守太微，亡君之戒，有徙王。

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "When Saturn guards the Supreme Palace Enclosure, it is warning of a lost ruler; there will be a moved king."
translations.idiomatic: Saturn’s long stay in the enclosure marks a dying dynasty and shifting kingship.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，太白入太微，犯左執法。

translations.literal: On day Yiwei in the ninth month, the Great White entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and transgressed the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: September, yiwei: Venus entered the enclosure and crossed the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: On day Dingsi, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi: the Moon entered the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: The prognostication states: "Great men will grieve."
translations.idiomatic: High lords face mourning.

translations.literal: On day Jiashen in the tenth month, the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: October, jiashen: the Moon entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將，仍順行，至左掖門內，留二十日，乃逆行。

translations.literal: On day Guisi, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, transgressed the western bastion’s senior commander, then moved direct to inside the left Censor Gate, halted twenty days, then retrograded.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi: Mars entered the enclosure, struck the western commander star, advanced to the left rear gate, stopped twenty days, then turned retrograde.

sentences.zh: 義熙十二年七月，劉裕伐姚泓。

translations.literal: In the twelfth Yixi year’s seventh month, Liu Yu campaigned against Yao Hong.
translations.idiomatic: Yixi twelve, July: Liu Yu attacked Later Qin’s Yao Hong.

sentences.zh: 十三年八月，禽姚泓，司、兗、秦、雍悉平。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year’s eighth month, he captured Yao Hong; Si, Yan, Qin, and Yong were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year, August: Yao Hong was taken and Si, Yan, Qin, and Yong were subdued.

sentences.zh: 十四年，劉裕還彭城，受宋公。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Liu Yu returned to Pengcheng and received the title Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year: Liu Yu came back to Pengcheng and took the Song dukedom.

sentences.zh: 十一月，左僕射前將軍劉穆之卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Left Director and former general Liu Muzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: November: Liu Muzhi, left director and ex-general, died.

sentences.zh: 明年，西虜寇長安，雍州刺史朱齡石諸軍陷沒，官軍舍而東。

translations.literal: The next year, western barbarians raided Chang’an; the hosts of Yong Inspector Zhu Lingshi were lost; the royal army abandoned it and moved east.
translations.idiomatic: Next year western foes struck Chang’an, Zhu Lingshi’s Yongzhou army was swallowed, and court forces abandoned the city for the east.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: December: the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 恭帝元熙元年正月丙午，三月壬寅，五月丙申，月皆犯太微，占悉同上。

translations.literal: In Emperor Gong’s first Yuanxi year, first month day Bingwu, third month day Renyin, and fifth month day Bingshen, the moon each transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure; the prognostications were all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxi one: the Moon crossed the Supreme Palace on bingwu, renyin, and bingshen with the usual enclosure glosses.

translations.literal: On day Yimao, Mercury transgressed the Coachman.
translations.idiomatic: Yimao: Mercury crossed Xuanyuan.
